ec74199d.title: Solution Architect, IT/ITES Vertical
ec74199d.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.  

  

Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.  

  

In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.  

  

You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.  

  

Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!  

\#aws\-ags\-India  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.

  

A day in the life  

Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!  

  

As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 3\+ years experience working in or with Global Captive Centers (GCC)

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job Title:** 
 Cloud Contact Center Consultant
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7\+ Years (Minimum 5 years in Cloud Contact Center Implementation)
   

  

**Location:** 
 PAN India / Hybrid
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Project Role Description**
 Design and deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performance cloud contact center solutions. Lead architecture, implementation, migration, and integration of enterprise contact center platforms while ensuring performance, reliability, and business alignment.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
* NICE CXone (NICE inContact)
* Cloud Contact Center Implementation
* IVR \& Omnichannel Solutions
* Contact Center Integrations


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Genesys Cloud CX
* Amazon Connect
* Sprinklr
* CI/CD \& DevOps Practices


**Experience**
* Minimum 7 years of overall IT experience.
* At least 5 years of hands\-on experience in Cloud Contact Center implementation and architecture.


**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 15 years of full\-time education.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade cloud contact center solutions using NICE CXone (NICE inContact) or equivalent platforms such as Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, or Sprinklr.
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation, migration, and deployment of cloud contact center platforms.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
* Configure and optimize voice, chat, email, SMS, IVR, routing strategies, bots, and workforce management capabilities.
* Design and implement integrations with CRM, ERP, and third\-party enterprise applications using APIs and middleware.
* Establish architecture standards, governance, and best practices across contact center implementations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, infrastructure, security, and engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide technical leadership during critical incidents.
* Prepare architecture documents, solution designs, deployment guides, and technical documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging cloud contact center technologies and recommend platform improvements.


**Required Skills**
* Strong expertise in NICE CXone (NICE inContact) architecture, implementation, and administration.
* Experience with cloud contact center platforms such as Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, or Sprinklr.
* Hands\-on experience implementing voice, IVR, omnichannel routing, chat, email, SMS, and workforce management solutions.
* Experience integrating contact center platforms with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ERP systems, and third\-party applications using APIs and middleware.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, security, authentication, and high availability.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

90694566.title: Tech S and T Cloud Dev-AI Product Engineer-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
90694566.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technical AI Product Engineer**
**4–7 Years \| \- Full\-time**
 If you want to move beyond experiments and build AI systems that truly power products and decisions—this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building next\-generation AI\-powered products and platforms that transform how businesses operate, make decisions, and engage with customers.
   

  

 As a Technical AI Product Engineer, you will design and deliver production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions—owning the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous optimization.
   

  

 This role is ideal for engineers who combine deep AI/ML expertise with strong engineering rigor and product thinking, and want to build scalable, measurable, and responsible AI systems in a real\-world enterprise setting.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI Products, Not Just Models**
* Design and develop GenAI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows
* Translate business problems into measurable AI\-driven outcomes
* Define evaluation metrics and product success criteria


**Engineer Intelligent Systems at Scale**
* Build and optimize retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
* Develop agent\-based AI systems with tool usage and orchestration
* Deploy solutions on cloud\-native architectures (Azure preferred)


**Own the AI Lifecycle (GenAI Ops)**
* Implement prompt engineering strategies, embeddings, and fine\-tuning approaches
* Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails for reliability and safety
* Enable continuous monitoring of quality, latency, and cost


**Drive Responsible \& Secure AI**
* Embed responsible AI practices (bias detection, explainability, moderation)
* Ensure data privacy, governance, and compliance standards
* Build systems aligned with enterprise security and trust principles


**Collaborate \& influence**
* Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to prioritize AI features
* Influence enterprise AI architecture and best practices
* Enable teams through reusable AI components and APIs


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong programming in Python and SQL
* Hands\-on experience with GenAI patterns: Prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings \& semantic search, Agentic workflows
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch / TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain / Semantic Kernel
* Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (Azure preferred): Azure OpenAI, Azure ML , Azure AI Search


**Engineering \& Platform Skills**
* Strong foundation in data processing (Pandas, NumPy, Spark/Databricks)
* Experience with MLOps / GenAI Ops: MLflow, pipelines, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps
* Experience building APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Understanding of monitoring, observability, and system reliability


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience building agent\-based or autonomous AI systems
* Cost optimization for LLM workloads
* Multi\-modal AI (text, image, voice)
* Frontend integration for AI\-driven experiences


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ Data Engineering, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in AI engineering or development


**Additional**
* Certifications in AI, genAI or Ganetic AI
* Experience with data governance, security, and compliance standards


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

70492a3e.title: Architect (ATC)
70492a3e.description:
The Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations D365 F\&O Solution Architect serves as the senior technical and functional leader responsible for the overall health, stability, and continuous improvement of ConnectAmerica's Microsoft Dynamics Finance \& Operations platform. This role provides architectural oversight, production support leadership, and strategic guidance for application managed services while ensuring the platform aligns with business objectives, Microsoft best practices, and enterprise architecture standards. The architect serves as the highest technical escalation point for complex production issues, major enhancements, integrations, and solution design. The role works closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership, Microsoft, third party vendors


The Solution Architect owns the end to end architecture of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations platform and designs scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support business processes. The role reviews and approves solution designs, customizations, integrations, and extensions while ensuring all enhancements align with Microsoft's extensibility framework and One Version upgrade strategy. Responsibilities also include developing architecture roadmaps, leading production support including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Procurement and Sourcing, Fixed Assets, Cash and Bank Management, Budgeting, Financial Reporting, Security and Role Based Access, Workflow, Electronic Reporting, Batch Processing, and Master Data Management. It also includes designing and governing integrations using Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Data Management Framework, OData, Dual Write, Power Platform, APIs, and middleware solutions


The ideal candidate has more than 10 years of Microsoft Dynamics ERP experience, including at least 5 years as a Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations Solution Architect supporting enterprise scale production environments. Strong expertise in Application Managed Services, Microsoft Lifecycle Services, Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, X\+\+, extensions, data entities, integration patterns, and stakeholder management is essential. Preferred qualifications include Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate, Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate

98887ed9.title: Technical Sales Leader - Single Use Solutions
98887ed9.description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------


.**Applications / Technical Sales Manager**  

**Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH) :** Single\-Use Solutions \| Bioprocessing \& Sterile Injectable Manufacturing

**Business:** Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH), Single\-Use Solutions

**Role level :** Senior technical sales / applications leadership; 15\+ years experience

**Primary focus :** Customer solution development, technical positioning, application support, and team leadership

**Industry coverage:** Biopharma, biotech, vaccines, biologicals, CDMOs, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing

**Regulated\-market exposure:** US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH\-regulated markets


The Opportunity

**Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH)** offers customized Single\-Use Solutions that cater to the unique needs of biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturers throughout the process workflow. Our solutions include single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and associated hardware designed to support critical manufacturing operations.


The role of an Applications / Technical Sales Manager is pivotal in creating impactful solutions for our customers. With deep process knowledge, technical expertise, and commercial acumen, the individual will lead a team of Application Specialists and deliver innovative solutions that address the unique application needs of clients across biopharmaceutical, vaccine, biological, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

**What We're Looking For**


Education

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biopharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines.


Experience

* 15\+ years of industry experience in Biopharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Vaccines, Biologicals, and/or Sterile Pharmaceutical Manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge across bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing workflows, including upstream processing, downstream processing, formulation, buffer/media preparation, sterile manufacturing, and fill\-finish operations.
* Experience working with external customers within the Biotech, Biologicals, Life Sciences, Vaccine, and/or Injectable Pharmaceutical industries.
* Experience supporting customers supplying products to highly regulated markets such as the United States, Europe, Japan, and other ICH\-regulated regions.
* Strong understanding of customer manufacturing processes, technical challenges, material requirements, and evolving industry expectations.


Regulatory \& Compliance Knowledge

* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to single\-use technologies used in biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of Extractables \& Leachables (E\&L), supplier qualification programs, GMP/cGMP expectations, change control, quality risk management, sterility assurance, contamination control, validation requirements, and regulatory expectations from US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other global agencies.
* Awareness of BPOG Single\-Use guidance and USP / ISO standards relevant to single\-use systems, fluid contact materials, sterilization, biocompatibility, and particulate control.


Personal Attributes

* Purpose\-driven, with passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges that advance life\-changing science.
* Customer\-focused, solution\-oriented, and able to convert technical insight into meaningful business impact.
* Strong leadership, communication, influencing, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


Who You Are

* A Subject Matter Expert (SME) who partners closely with commercial teams, product managers, quality teams, and R\&D scientists to achieve business objectives.
* Possess deep understanding of bioprocessing workflows and/or sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
* Strong understanding of customer technical challenges, process requirements, material requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Capable of engaging effectively with stakeholders across Process Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement.
* Demonstrated project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical engagements and strategic opportunities.
* Able to develop and maintain strong technical relationships with targeted key accounts.
* Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving AFH products, solutions, and service offerings.
* Possess strong knowledge of regulatory expectations associated with single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and critical process components used in regulated manufacturing environments.


How You Will Thrive and Create an Impact

* Play a key role in identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing project opportunities, ensuring effective support for both internal and external customers.
* Contribute to the technical positioning of AFH products within customer manufacturing processes and influence strategic decision\-making.
* Improve the quality, competitiveness, and value proposition of AFH products and service offerings.
* Gather, compile, and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to identify unmet needs and create differentiated solutions.
* Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging market trends to guide future product and service development.
* Stay current with industry, technology, and regulatory developments and communicate insights across the organization.
* Support local and global sales processes, strategic account management initiatives, and business growth objectives.
* Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers within strategic customer accounts.
* Provide technical and regulatory guidance regarding implementation, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of single\-use systems.
* Support customer discussions related to supplier qualification, extractables and leachables assessments, contamination control strategies, particulate risk management, sterilization validation, and change management processes.
* Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, Operations, and R\&D teams to ensure AFH solutions align with current and evolving regulations and standards.
* Participate in customer audits, technical reviews, product evaluations, and qualification activities as required.
* Support both biopharmaceutical and sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing customers in achieving compliance, operational excellence, and process optimization.

**Preferred Industry Experience**


Candidates with experience supporting leading biopharmaceutical, vaccine, CDMO, biologics, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturers supplying regulated markets such as US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH\-regulated regions will be highly preferred.


Biopharma / Biotech Applications


Sterile Injectable / Regulated Pharma Applications


Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs)


VaccinesRecombinant proteins


Cell \& gene therapies


Plasma products


CDMO biologics manufacturing


Aseptic / fill\-finish operations


Sterile injectables


Small Volume Parenterals (SVPs)


Large Volume Parenterals (LVPs)


Complex generic injectables


US \& EU regulated\-market supply


Success Profile

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  

The ideal candidate combines deep bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing expertise, strong understanding of single\-use technologies, knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements for regulated markets, proven technical sales and key account management experience, leadership capability to build high\-performing technical teams, and the ability to translate customer needs into commercially successful solutions.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by


employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of


all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of employees assigned to this position.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.

d675af25.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
d675af25.description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery


 You will act as:
   

  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities


 Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
   

  

**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


 Lastly, what we are not looking for
 **,** 
 we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

2d423b91.title: Engagement Manager
2d423b91.description:
**Company Overview**
 Planview has one mission: to build the future of connected work, from ideas to impact.
   

  

 As the global leader in work and resource management, Planview helps organizations accelerate the achievement of what matters most, supporting our customers from need to speed, from passion to progress, and from overhead to optimization. We provide the industry’s most comprehensive solutions designed for strategic planning, portfolio and resource management, Lean and Agile delivery, product portfolio management, capability, and technology management (enterprise architecture), innovation management, and collaborative work and project management. Our connected platform of solutions underpins the business and digital transformations of more than 4,500 customers globally, including 59 of the Fortune 100\.
   

  

 At Planview, our people connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1400\+ work remotely and across our offices including Austin, Vancouver, Hod Hasharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We’re proud of our world\-class, connected culture built on our shared values, that supports our teams to be successful from anywhere.
   

  

 Learn more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Planview’s growing
 **India \& SEA Professional Services team** 
 has an exciting opportunity for an
 **Engagement Manager** 
 to join the organization.
   

  

 The successful candidate will become part of the fast\-paced, high\-energy Professional Services team, playing a pivotal role in
 **linking Planview’s core value streams to customer outcomes** 
 and ensuring value is delivered to our customers.
   

  

 The
 **Engagement Manager is a customer\-facing domain expert** 
 who is delivery\-focused and outcome\-driven, with a passion for delighting customers through the successful delivery of Planview products and services.
   

  

 Implementations will include
 **Planview solutions such as Project Portfolio Management and Agile Portfolio Management** 
 . The successful candidate will demonstrate thought leadership and innovative approaches, consistently delivering exceptional customer experiences at every moment that matters.
   

  

 In this customer\-obsessed role, the Engagement Manager will work to understand each customer’s desired environment, methodologies, processes, and portfolio or program management approach. They will
 **lead a matrixed Professional Services team** 
 to guide customers through the
 **design and implementation of their solutions** 
 .
   

  

 The role carries full accountability for
 **delivering customer implementations from outset to completion** 
 , ensuring customers realise value in the shortest possible timeframe while achieving their business outcomes and goals.
   

  

 The successful candidate will continually strive to exceed Planview’s customer expectations while positively influencing revenue and profitability.
   

  

 Qualified candidates will demonstrate the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced, high\-volume environment, balancing diverse needs to drive the success of both our customers and our business.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage multiple Professional Services projects from initiation to closure, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget and customer satisfaction.
* Apply PMI, PRINCE2, and SAFe methodologies \& principles in customer projects in terms of Break down tasks, create project plans, and manage risks using these frameworks
* Maintain PMI, PRINCE 2 certifications
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, issues/risk registers and budgets. Proactively manage project activity to deliver project within as sold margins.
* Ensure resource requirements are reflected accurately in the project plan. Maintain accurate resource allocations (task assignment, effort and duration) in project plan
* Lead project teams, assigning tasks, providing direction, and monitoring progress. Ensure project governance structure (e.g. steering committee) is put into place and executed
* Proactively identify and address project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies as needed. Escalate 'at risk' implementations to ensure timely awareness for PS leadership.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, managing client expectations and relationships.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kick\-off meetings, status meetings, and steering committee meetings. Prepare and deliver project status reports and presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support the development of project proposals and contribute to business development efforts.
* Proactively manage project financials to ensure accuracy of revenue forecasts. Provide early notice to PS LT of potential slippage, project delays, issues and escalations.
* Ensure project governance structure (e.g. steering committee) is put into place and executed


**What You'll Bring**
* Possess skills in conceptualizing creative solutions and communicating them to others including senior management.
* Ability to articulate the value of Planview Solutions and using your consulting skills to position the prescribed services to achieve the customer’s business outcomes.
* Ability to develop multiple levels of relationships with the customer to ensure customer acceptance of responsibilities to deploy an effective solution.
* Provide thought leadership to customers methods and approaches that enable the realization of value from project, portfolio, and resource management practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects to closure.
* Must have demonstrated understanding of the implementation approach elements including; Business outcome definition, Linking of key analytics and decisions to business outcomes. Workshop facilitation to ensure discussions remain within scope. Assess and advise on process design and documentation. Provide quality professional services deliverables, executive\-level presentations, and status reporting.
* Demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Experience responding and resolving conflicting issues and customer requirements in a variety of customer or client situations and personalities.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and show patience within a variety of customer situations.
* Work independently and have experience in lean Agile transformation projects.
* Willingness to travel approximately 60%
* Experience with a variety of software platforms and delivery methods including web\-based and cloud\-based systems, SQL and basic technology tools including MS Office, MS Visio, MS SharePoint, MS Reporting Services, etc.
* Experience and/or knowledge of legacy and current ALM solutions, i.e. Jira, ADO, Rally, CollabNet, HP\-ALM, Jira Align (AgileCraft), VersionOne, Octane, etc.
* Experience in guiding teams on Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP, SAFe, etc.).
* Strong collaborator and team player working with the broader Planview consulting team to ensure customer success.
* Prior experience with Project governance, Project and Portfolio Management and/or financial reporting tools


**Ideal Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Management of Information Science, or Business (or related degree) or demonstrated relevant experience.
* A minimum of 6 years of client\-facing consulting experience with an ability to demonstrate previous results across different industry sectors.
* Broad understanding of software implementation, quality assurance, business process analysis, organization change management and system integrations.
* Cross functional knowledge of technical domain based on the product(s) supported (e.g., strategic and financial planning, lean portfolio management, project/resource management, enterprise architecture, product development lifecycle etc.)
* Ability to learn and apply industry knowledge and understanding of the business to drive revenue.
* Ability to gain deep technical knowledge of product(s) supported.
* Agile certifications a plus (e.g. SAFe Agilest, SPC, LPM, CSM, CPO, PMI, etc.)
* Experience in ALM tool integration technologies and APIs a plus (e.g. TaskTop, OpsHub, ConnectAll, etc.)
* Related certifications or industry designations (e.g. PMP, CPA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, ITIL etc.)


**Benefits At Planview**
 At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
   

  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company\-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.


 Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best\-in\-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

None

20e8c90d.title: Technical Program Manager
20e8c90d.description:
**Position: Technical Program Manager** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Reports to: Director of Engineering** 




**Years of experience: 6\+** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 MoxiWorks is the leading real estate AI marketing platform built by real estate pros, for real estate pros. Our AI‑powered system helps brokerages and their agents find, win, and close more deals.
 



 Drawing on decades of industry expertise, we build tools that remove complexity and let real estate professionals focus on what matters most. Our newest innovation, RISE, is a native‑AI sales and marketing tool designed to help agents stay ahead in an increasingly competitive landscape.
 



  





 At MoxiWorks, you’ll find a team of innovators, collaborators, and doers who care deeply about our customers, our craft, and each other. If you’re excited by meaningful work, big ideas, and building technology that empowers people, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





 Our Pune team plays a critical role in delivering these innovations. As part of our global engineering and technology organization, you'll collaborate with talented colleagues across the United States and India to build products used by more than 3,000 brokerages and 400,000 real estate professionals worldwide.
 



  





 If you're passionate about solving meaningful problems, building high\-quality software, and working in a collaborative, growth\-oriented environment, we'd love to have you on our team.
 



  





**Our Core Values** 



* Customer First
* Innovative
* Passionate
* Sense of Urgency
* Accountable \& Reliable
* Relentless Execution



  





 Join MoxiWorks in Pune and help shape the future of PropTech while growing your career with a global team committed to innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
 



  





**Your Next Opportunity:** 




**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to play a critical role in the delivery of our new, innovative AI platform \- RISE. As the Technical Scrum Master / Program Manager, you are the primary custodian of team productivity and delivery health. You are not just a meeting facilitator, but a "flow master" responsible for optimizing the end\-to\-end value stream—from product discovery to production release. You will bridge the gap between strategic product vision and technical execution, ensuring high\-energy squads remain focused, unblocked, and aligned with mission\-critical goals.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Flow Optimization \& Mastery: Act as the "bulldozer" for the team, identifying and aggressively removing technical and organizational impediments that hinder velocity.
* Agile Facilitation: Lead high\-energy Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Planning, Retrospectives) and refine Kanban/Scrum processes to maintain a constant, sustainable work pace.
* Technical Delivery Oversight: Use your technical background to engage in architecture discussions and issue triage, addressing first\-level blockers before they reach engineering management.
* Stakeholder \& Product Alignment: Partner with Product Owners to manage and groom backlogs, ensuring technical debt and architectural initiatives are balanced with feature delivery.
* Metric\-Driven Improvement: Track and analyze flow metrics (Cycle Time, Lead Time, Velocity, and Throughput) to identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
* Shielding \& Focus: Protect the team from external disruptions and "scope creep" by acting as the primary point of contact for stakeholders during active sprints.
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership
* Create and maintain program reports, dashboards, and executive\-ready views of delivery health



  





**Required Skills** 



* Agile Expert: Mastery of Scrum, Kanban, and Lean principles, with experience applying them in "high\-intensity" product environments.
* Program Management: Proven ability to manage dependencies across multiple cross\-functional teams and maintain a high\-level roadmap while managing tactical sprint tasks.
* Technical Acumen: Ability to "speak the same language" as developers—understanding CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and modern web architectures (e.g., ROR/React).
* Tools Mastery: Power user of Jira and Confluence, capable of building advanced dashboards and automation workflows to visualize team health.



  





**What This Role Solves** 



* Missed or unpredictable delivery timelines
* Poor or inconsistent cross\-team coordination
* Unclear ownership and accountability
* Misalignment between Engineering, Product, and Business stakeholders








**Seniority \& Experience** 



* 6\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or a related role
* Proven success driving cross\-team software delivery
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments
* Platform, infrastructure, or large\-scale product experience is a plus








**Leadership Traits \& Soft Skills** 



* Strong self\-starter with a bias toward action and delivery
* Comfortable engaging in healthy conflict and holding teams accountable
* Direct, clear, and confident communicator
* Resilient under pressure and comfortable with difficult conversations



  





**Moxians Are Covered:** 




 All benefits are subject to review on an annual basis whereas we continuously assess our total reward proposition aligning with the needs of our people, our business and the market. Benefits are effective on 1st day of employment
 



  




* Medical insurance for employees and family, including parents/in\-laws
* Accident coverage for employees
* EAP powered by Living App
* Catered lunch
* Indoor games and team engagement
* Office snacks and refreshments
* Public holidays 10 days
* 20 PTOs and 6 CL/SL, full maternity and 4 weeks paternity

5cddc99e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Cloud Silicon
5cddc99e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in architecture, design, verification, implementation, or validation across 7 chip development cycles.
* Experience with managing technical cross\-functional projects.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, or a related field.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience as an engineer or manager in developing hardware or software systems around the chips.
* Experience with two or more chip cycles in a project management role with execution within resource and schedule constraints.
* Knowledge of data centers and cloud markets, technological and business trends, requirements, and ecosystem partners.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills.


**About the job** 
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Justify, plan, coordinate, and deliver custom silicon products.
* Generate task lists, build project timeline and work with the teams to make it reality.
* Lead the creation of data\-motivated schedules and milestones, track the progress, identify potential future tests, and identify mitigations with the multiple team leaders.
* Drive technical, budgetary, and schedule trade\-off discussions with cross\-functional teams.
* Manage project execution and issues as they arise through design, development, test, manufacturing, deployment and sustaining activities for silicon and hardware products.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

2be92890.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2be92890.description:
**About Ditto**
 At Ditto, we're redefining digital trust. Our unified identity platform helps banks, financial institutions, governments and other regulated organisations verify identities, prevent fraud and deliver secure digital experiences through identity verification, authentication, passwordless access and mobile threat defence. As we continue to grow globally, we're building a continuous trust platform that protects every interaction across the customer journey.
   

  

 We're a global team with a startup mindset — moving fast, thinking big and empowering people to make an impact from day one. Led by CEO Gonzalo Alonso and an experienced leadership team, we're on a mission to make digital trust simple, secure and accessible. This role sits within our Pune office, the engineering and delivery heart of the Ditto authentication platform.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Ditto continues to scale, we're looking for a senior Technical Program Manager who thinks and executes “stratactically” — strategic in framing, tactical in getting things done. This is a versatile, high\-trust role that flexes across both external (customer\-facing) and internal programmes. You'll land with customers and build credibility, get to the heart of escalations, drive process and operational improvements, and use data to guide conversations and decisions — bringing people along with you at every step, inside and outside the company.
   

  

 A meaningful part of your time may go into running a sizeable product implementation track, but that's one application of the role, not its definition. The essence of the job is applying this senior skillset wherever it creates the most leverage — internal or external. This is not a coordinator role: we're seeking someone technically grounded, business\-aware and execution\-focused, who creates clarity, momentum and predictability in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Where You'll Make an Impact**
**In This Role, You'll**
* Land with customers, build durable relationships, and run programme governance — kick\-offs, cadence calls and steering updates — that keep them confident and well\-informed.
* Own escalations end to end across delivery, product and live/production customers — get to root cause, mobilise the right people, and drive resolution while keeping stakeholders updated.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and dependencies, drive them down before they impact delivery, and keep stakeholders informed ahead of time.
* Apply the same rigour across both customer implementations and internal programmes — building plans, sequencing work and driving outcomes wherever you're pointed.
* Prepare and present clear, concise weekly status updates to Sales, Solution Consulting and Leadership, covering progress, risks, blockers and next steps.
* Define, document and continuously improve how the team works — intake, planning, execution, quality gates and hand\-offs — driving adoption of consistent, repeatable practice.
* Track and report the metrics that matter, turning data into insight that helps leadership make timely, informed decisions.
* Act as the bridge across Product Implementation, Sales, Solution Consulting, Engineering, Product, leadership and the customer — keeping everyone aligned and rowing in the same direction.
* Where assigned, own end\-to\-end delivery of a sizeable product implementation track — plans, milestones, scope and go\-live readiness — working closely with Engineering.
* Actively use large language models and AI tools to accelerate reporting, documentation, planning and issue triage, championing their adoption across the team.


**Who You Are**
 You're someone who:
   

  

* Thinks strategically and executes tactically — sets direction and personally drives it through to done.
* Thrives with a startup mindset — self\-motivated, resourceful and comfortable operating with ambiguity and minimal guidance.
* Takes end\-to\-end ownership and accountability for outcomes, following through to the finish.
* Communicates clearly, translating technical complexity into simple, accurate updates for business and customer audiences.
* Builds bridges and brings people along — across Sales, Solution Consulting, Engineering, Product and customers.
* Is results\-driven, focused on measurable outcomes and impact rather than activity, with a global mindset that adapts across cultures.


**What We're Looking For**
 Ideally, you'll bring:
   

  

* 8–15 years of overall experience, including at least 8 years in technical programme or project management delivering enterprise software or complex cross\-functional programmes.
* A track record of operating across both customer\-facing and internal programmes — not delivery execution alone — with proven success managing multiple concurrent engagements to on\-time completion.
* Strong working understanding of software deployment — servers, integrations, environments, authentication configuration, security hardening, go\-lives and version migrations.
* Fluency with data — able to build and present crisp, insight\-led updates for customers, Sales, Solution Consulting and senior leadership.
* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience), with an excellent grasp of SDLC, deployment lifecycles and agile methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with programme/project tools (e.g. Atlassian, Miro, MS tools) and excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across technical and business audiences.


**Bonus Points**
**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**
* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) / Agile certification.
* Exposure to cybersecurity, authentication, identity or fraud\-prevention products.
* Familiarity with cloud, hybrid and on\-premises deployment models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux\-based server environments.
* Understanding of regulated\-industry delivery (financial services, banking) and associated compliance expectations.
* Experience introducing or improving delivery and operational processes in a scaling or startup environment.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, you'll:
   

  

* Be recognised by customers as a credible, dependable senior point of contact who keeps programmes on track and expectations well\-managed.
* Resolve escalations calmly and quickly, with root causes addressed and the right people mobilised at the right time.
* Bring visible order and repeatable process to previously ad hoc ways of working, adopted consistently across teams.
* Equip Sales, Solution Consulting and Leadership with the data and insight they need to make timely, confident decisions.


**Why Join Ditto**
 Join a fast\-growing, international team solving complex identity and security challenges for organisations around the world. You'll operate at the centre of both our customer relationships and our internal delivery engine, with real room to shape how we work as we scale. It's a senior, high\-trust role with genuine breadth — you won't be boxed into a single track.
   

  

 We value ownership, curiosity and collaboration, giving our people the freedom to make decisions, challenge ideas and grow their careers — including hands\-on experience applying large language models and AI tools to drive delivery and operational productivity — while helping build the future of digital trust.
   

  

**Location \& Ways of Working**
* Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
* Working pattern: Hybrid with 2/3 days a week in the office
* Travel: Occasional
* Employment type: Full\-time, Permanent
* Reports to: CTO


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
 We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities.

c3789f9a.title: Lead Digital Solutions Consultant
c3789f9a.description:
**Overview**
**About Business Unit:**
 As part of the Digital Integration Services team, you’ll be at the forefront of modernizing marketing and delivering ground\-breaking solutions. From crafting data\-driven, personalized experiences that customers truly value to turning marketing visions into reality \- we empower brands to achieve their goals.
   

  

 Our team of 1,200 experts in strategy, analytics, creative, and digital experience uses innovative technology and data\-driven insights to craft relevant, customer\-centric strategies for the world’s leading brands.

* You have a strong consulting mentality and enjoy helping clients navigate digital transformation initiatives.
* You can connect business objectives with technology capabilities to create meaningful and measurable outcomes.
* You thrive at facilitating discussions, challenging assumptions, and driving clarity in ambiguous situations.
* You are effective at building trusted relationships with partners across business and technology functions.

* You thrive in collaborative environments and can influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.

**What You Will Enjoy In This Role**
 As part of the Digital Experience team
   

  

* Influence strategic decisions by collaborating directly with business leaders, product owners, technology teams, and executive partners across enterprise\-scale programs.
* Shape solutions from concept to realization, participating in discovery workshops, strategy discussions, solution definition, implementation planning, and value realization.
* Gain exposure to a diverse ecosystem of digital technologies, customer experience platforms, data and AI solutions, content and commerce platforms, and emerging enterprise technologies.
* Contribute to transformational initiatives that help organizations reimagine customer experiences, modernize business processes, and accelerate digital adoption.
* Work with cross\-functional teams comprising strategists, architects, designers, product specialists, engineers, and delivery leaders, providing opportunities to build a broad consulting skills.
* Take ownership of meaningful client engagements where your ideas, recommendations, and insights can directly influence project outcomes and business value.


 Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with business partners and clients to understand strategic objectives, customer experience goals, business processes, and technology challenges, translating business needs into actionable requirements and solution outcomes.

* Facilitate requirement discussions and solution workshops, driving alignment, decision\-making, and consensus among business and technology partners.
* Translate complex business challenges into clear functional, non\-functional, and operational requirements, ensuring solution designs meet both business and user needs.
* Define and document business processes, functional and business requirement, customer journeys, operating models, and future\-state capabilities that support transformation initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* Drive data, analytics, and reporting requirements, including Key Performance Indicator identification, measurement frameworks, governance considerations, and business insight generation.
* Support digital platform, customer experience, marketing technology, CRM, commerce, content management, and data transformation initiatives through solution definition and partner engagement.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled and data\-driven transformation initiatives by identifying business opportunities, defining use cases, evaluating value realization, and supporting adoption of emerging technologies.
* Support Agile delivery and product management practices, including backlog management, user story creation, sprint planning, prioritization, partner communication, and release readiness activities.
* Participate in testing, validation, change management, training, and adoption activities to ensure successful rollout and realization of business value.
* Act as a trusted advisor to partners by providing recommendations, identifying risks and dependencies, and helping teams make informed business and technology decisions.
* Continuously evaluate industry trends, emerging technologies, and leading practices to help clients and internal teams see opportunities for innovation and improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Requires overall experience of 8\-10 years and at least 4\-6 years in client\-facing roles
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred. MBA from a reputed Business School with Marketing specialization (Also Non\-MBA, with exceptional communication skills)

 Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.
   

  

 Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400\+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real\-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry\-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.

* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability


 These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.

 Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

55789189.title: AI Solutions Architect
55789189.description:
**Role Summary:** 




 Design and deliver enterprise\-grade AI solutions for regulated healthcare environments. Own architecture for assigned products and workstreams across Agentic AI, GenAI, traditional ML, application, and data layers. Stay hands\-on through incubation, contribute to pre\-sales and customer engagements alongside Lead Architects and Delivery Leaders, and mentor engineers on AI engineering practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **End\-to\-end AI architecture:** 
 Architect Agentic AI, GenAI, RAG, and traditional ML solutions across assigned products and workstreams, from design through production deployment.
* **Agentic systems:** 
 Design and build multi\-agent flows — agent orchestration, tool/function calling, planning and reasoning patterns, memory, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* **Hybrid AI design:** 
 Combine deterministic rules, statistical models, explainable ML, and LLM\-based reasoning for high\-precision, auditable outcomes.
* **GenAI stack:** 
 Design LLM orchestration, RAG, vector stores, prompt engineering, evaluation, grounding, and HITL workflows.
* **Governance \& compliance:** 
 Apply AI governance, security, and compliance practices — explainability, PHI handling, HIPAA, HITRUST, and responsible AI.
* **MLOps / LLMOps:** 
 Implement model and agent CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, observability, and cost/latency optimization.
* **Pre\-sales:** 
 Contribute to solutioning, estimation, execution approach, and delivery plans; co\-author technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and SoWs under Lead Architect guidance.
* **Customer partnership:** 
 Run discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and solution walkthroughs with client architects and business stakeholders; partner with Lead Architects and Delivery Leaders to understand customer context.
* **Project incubation:** 
 Hands\-on build of PoCs, architecture spikes, and MVPs — establishing the technical foundation that delivery teams scale.
* **Application \& data architecture:** 
 Design microservices, APIs, event\-driven patterns, data lakes/lakehouses, streaming pipelines, and EMR/enterprise integrations for AI products.
* **Business outcomes:** 
 Translate problems into AI capabilities across healthcare sub\-segments like EMR, Patient services and engagement, Medical devices, Medical Imaging, RCM, etc.
* **Mentorship:** 
 Mentor engineers and junior architects; run design reviews within the workstream.



  





**Required Skills:** 




**Agentic AI** 



* Hands\-on experience building agentic systems — single\-agent and multi\-agent flows with planning, tool/function calling, memory, and guardrails.
* Working experience with at least one of LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Bedrock Agents, or OpenAI Agents/Assistants.
* Familiarity with evaluation, observability, tracing, and safety controls for agentic workloads.



**GenAI, ML \& AI Governance** 



* Solid working experience across the GenAI stack: LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation, grounding, and HITL workflows.
* Hands\-on with at least one major platform — AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or an open\-source LLM ecosystem.
* Experience building hybrid AI flows that combine rules, statistical models, ML, and LLM reasoning.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, security, and compliance: PHI handling, HIPAA, explainability, responsible AI.



**Healthcare Domain** 



* Hands\-on experience building healthcare AI solutions in at least one of: medical imaging, medical devices, EMR, patient engagement, RCM, patient services, life sciences (clinical trials, genomics).
* Working knowledge of FHIR, HL7, EDI 837/835, or EHR integrations.
* Ability to deliver AI capabilities for areas such as denial prediction, revenue integrity, coding optimization, risk analytics, workflow automation, or copilots/assistants.



**Pre\-sales \& Solutioning** 



* Experience contributing to pre\-sales — solutioning, estimation (effort, team mix, timeline), execution method, and delivery plans under Lead Architect guidance.
* Experience co\-authoring technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and SoWs; comfortable presenting solution components in client conversations.
* Effective collaboration with other Architects, Delivery Leaders, and Sales to understand customer context.



**Nice to Have** 



* Open\-source contributions, technical blogs, patents, or publications in AI/ML.
* Exposure to healthcare interoperability platforms, payer\-provider data exchange, or clinical decision support.
* Certifications in cloud architecture, AI/ML, or healthcare compliance.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* 8–12 years of total IT experience.
* 4–6\+ years of dedicated technical architecture experience across AI/ML and application/data architecture.
* Track record of delivering production AI in regulated environments (healthcare preferred).



  





**About CitiusTech:** 




 CitiusTech is a global technology services, consulting, and business solutions enterprise 100% focused on the healthcare and life sciences industry. We enable 140\+ enterprises to build a human\-first ecosystem that is efficient, effective, and equitable. Leveraging deep domain expertise and next\-generation technologies including AI, Cloud, Data, and Intelligent Automation, we assist our clients to realize their vision, accelerate transformation, and achieve business outcomes. With 7,700\+ healthcare technology professionals worldwide, CitiusTech powers digital innovation, business transformation, and industry\-wide convergence through next\-generation technologies, solutions, and products.

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 Bengaluru, KA

This entails translating business ambition and product vision and combining it with technical execution to create practical and scalable, and AI\-native end\-to\-end solutions that deliver real outcomes.

**Description**
 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 3\+ years experience working in or with Global Captive Centers (GCC)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Delhi
