d5c8eeaf.title: Architect
d5c8eeaf.description:
**Job Summary**
 Architect role in a global organization responsible for designing scalable data and cloud solutions using AWS Cloud SQL data catalog and data integration capabilities. The role focuses on optimizing performance ensuring data reliability and enabling secure hybrid analytics platforms that empower business teams working with devices domain insights while operating in a day shift hybrid work model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design robust end to end data architectures on AWS Cloud that support complex analytics and operational workloads while ensuring scalability reliability and efficiency across hybrid environments
* Develop and refine data integration patterns that consolidate information from diverse enterprise and devices domain sources into unified and trusted data platforms
* Optimize SQL queries and database structures with advanced performance tuning techniques to deliver consistent low latency responses for critical business applications
* Implement secure data catalog solutions that standardize metadata management improve discoverability of data assets and enhance governance and compliance across the organization
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to translate strategic business requirements into practical data and cloud solution designs that deliver measurable outcomes for customers and society
* Establish best practices for data ingestion transformation and storage that balance performance cost and resilience while aligning to enterprise architecture standards
* Provide technical guidance to project teams on AWS cloud services SQL optimization methods and data integration tools to ensure solutions are robust maintainable and aligned with architectural principles
* Review and validate solution designs and implementation approaches to confirm adherence to nonfunctional requirements such as scalability reliability security and performance
* Create detailed technical documentation including architecture diagrams data flow specifications and configuration guidelines that support long term maintainability and knowledge sharing
* Drive continuous improvement of data platforms by evaluating emerging cloud and data technologies and proposing pragmatic enhancements that strengthen analytics capabilities and business agility
* Coordinate with operations and support teams to ensure smooth deployment monitoring and incident resolution for data and cloud solutions minimizing disruption to day shift hybrid users
* Advocate for responsible and ethical use of data by embedding privacy quality and governance considerations into every architectural decision thereby contributing to positive societal impact
* Collaborate within the hybrid work model using virtual and onsite interactions to maintain strong communication alignment and timely delivery of architectural outputs without requiring travel


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive experience in architecting solutions on AWS Cloud including design of compute storage networking and security configurations that meet enterprise standards
* Possess strong proficiency in SQL with hands on expertise in performance tuning indexing query optimization and schema design for high volume transactional and analytical workloads
* Show proven capability in implementing and managing data catalog platforms that organize metadata enable data lineage tracking and streamline user access to trusted datasets
* Exhibit solid experience in data integration using batch and real time patterns across heterogeneous systems ensuring reliable data movement transformation and reconciliation
* Bring practical understanding of devices domain data such as telemetry sensor readings and usage metrics and be able to incorporate these patterns into architecture designs as a desirable skill
* Apply advanced problem solving skills and structured thinking to evaluate trade offs between performance cost security and maintainability when defining solution architectures


**Certifications Required**
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect and certification in SQL or data engineering technologies preferred

16edbba8.title: Senior Manager- AI Strategy & Solutions
16edbba8.description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8–10\+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large\-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
* Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives
* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and influence across technical and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decisions
* Ability to build strong relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed environment without direct authority. Experience aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade\-offs, and timelines
* Experience driving execution across multiple stakeholder groups
* Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
* Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value
* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Data Science or related field)
* Experience leading enterprise programs
* Financial services or regulated industry experience
* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership
* Familiarity with AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Experience in consulting, strategy, or similar roles supporting enterprise transformation initiatives

**In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. 50f7a8e9.description:

60baac96.title: Sr. Program Manager, Buyer Abuse
60baac96.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.
   

  

 BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.
   

  

 BAP is seeking an innovative, results\-oriented, and customer\-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions\-of\-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under\-enforcement) and customer experience (over\-enforcement) metrics.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
* Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under\-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over\-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
* Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer\-facing impact metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM\-powered enforcement, model\-based auto\-decisions, and workflow automation.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
* Conduct in\-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
* Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting\-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first\-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
   

  

 We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in\-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
   

  

 Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
   

  

 If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

You have a deep understanding of Firework’s products market fit and are the subject matter expert with technical knowledge regarding our suite of products and alignment to a variety of different verticals. * Drive the onboarding process by bringing solutions discovery, technical enablement, product deployment assessment, and platform integration expertise

* Triage and resolve bugs and other technical issues throughout the customer journey
* Continuously create mapping of manual or automated requirements, tests, dependencies, integration playbooks, and technical documents


**We’ll be excited if you have**
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science or other technical field
* 3\+ years of solution engineering experience or technical consultant manager especially in a customer\-facing role for SaaS high\-growth companies
* Advanced verbal and written communication skills in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese are required
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with various technical and non\-technical audiences; must have strong empathy and emotional intelligence with diverse customers
* Advanced technical discovery, documentation, and troubleshooting skills. Detail\-minded and data driven.

9c4477e3.title: Enterprise Architect
9c4477e3.description:
**Location:** IN \- Bangalore 24/7 \| **Job\-ID:** 219766 \| **Contract type:** Standard \| **Business Unit:** IT Consulting **Life on the Team**

Define and govern the enterprise architecture for Artificial Intelligence, enabling AI capabilities to be adopted, governed and scaled securely across Computacenter. Shape AI roadmaps, principles, controls and transformation plan that align emerging AI capabilities with business outcomes, customer value and organisational change. Work across executive leadership, product teams, technology functions and business stakeholders to integrate AI across platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP and Genesys.  

**What You'll Do**
**Core Accountabilities**
* You will influence business and technology stakeholders to make informed decisions on AI adoption, balancing innovation, risk, cost, speed of execution and measurable value. You will stay current with AI, data, platform, security and regulatory trends, helping leaders understand both the opportunities and risks associated with AI\-enabled transformation.


**AI Enterprise Architecture**
* Define strategic architecture for generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, knowledge management, customer experience and digital workplace transformation.
* Create and evolve AI roadmaps, architecture principles, governance frameworks, standards and guardrails that support secure, ethical, scalable and commercially sustainable AI adoption.
* Work closely with product teams, Solution Architecture and delivery teams to ensure AI\-enabled solutions are viable, secure by design, aligned with enterprise architecture principles and able to deliver required business outcomes.
* Support business\-led transformation programmes by translating AI strategy into practical platform choices, operating model changes, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure AI capabilities are integrated effectively across key enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Genesys, Fabric and Power Platform.
* Lead architecture governance and assurance for AI\-related change, ensuring controls, data usage, security, ethical considerations and risk decisions are appropriate and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
* Act as the bridge between business strategy and delivery teams, providing thought leadership, architectural decision\-making and practical guidance on responsible AI adoption.
* Contribute actively to CTO practice development, including EA tooling, reusable AI patterns, reference architectures and decision artefacts that support effective portfolio, platform and transformation planning.


**Critical Success Factors**
* Clear alignment of AI architecture decisions with business strategy, customer outcomes, technology strategy, risk appetite and value delivery.
* Quality AI roadmaps, principles, governance artefacts, reusable patterns and controls that guide portfolio and investment decisions.
* Responsible, secure and ethical AI adoption embedded into business and technology change through practical standards and assurance.
* Effective integration of AI capabilities across enterprise platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP and Genesys.
* Trusted relationships with executive leadership, product teams, technology functions, data, security and business stakeholders.
* Ability to help programmes balance innovation, risk, cost and speed of execution while scaling sustainable AI capability.
* Continuous learning and education, keeping pace with emerging AI technologies, regulations, market trends and enterprise architecture practices.

  

  

**What You'll Need**
**Essential**
* Proven enterprise architecture experience across business capability modelling, roadmaps, principles, standards, governance and technology strategy.
* Deep understanding of AI and data\-driven architectures, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and knowledge management.
* Experience shaping AI roadmaps, governance frameworks, controls and transformation plans aligned to business outcomes and risk appetite.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft’s AI ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Fabric and Power Platform.
* Practical experience integrating AI capabilities across enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Genesys.
* Knowledge of frameworks and methods including TOGAF, ArchiMate, SAFe, ITIL, FinOps, DevSecOps, Responsible AI principles, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and ISO 27001\.
* Experience with enterprise architecture and modelling tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, ArchiMate or Sparx EA.
* Relevant professional accreditations desirable, such as TOGAF, CISSP, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Microsoft Applied Skills for Azure AI and Copilot technologies, SAFe and major cloud architecture certifications.
* Ability to translate complex technical AI concepts into clear business outcomes for senior leaders and delivery teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, influencing and commercial awareness.


**Leadership Requirements**
* Operates confidently from delivery teams through to CXO\-level stakeholders, translating AI strategy, platform choices and risk considerations into clear business outcomes.
* Combines strategic vision with pragmatic delivery capability, ensuring AI strategies can be turned into executable roadmaps and governed change.
* Demonstrates strong influencing, coaching and facilitation skills across business, technology, product, data, security and vendor teams.
* Shows intellectual curiosity, technology breadth, commercial awareness and credibility to engage directly with senior leaders and technical specialists.
* Maintains a balanced view of innovation, risk, cost and speed of execution so that AI adoption delivers measurable and sustainable value.
* Builds confidence across business and technology communities, helping the organisation navigate ambiguity and organisational change.

  


**About us**

Computacenter is a leading independent provider of IT infrastructure services, with about 21,000 employees worldwide. We work at the heart of digitisation, advising organisations on IT strategy, implementing the most appropriate technology and managing our customers’ infrastructures.  



We offer a friendly, open working environment without too much fuss about hierarchy. We are looking for professionals with diverse competencies, personalities and strengths who want to live our shared value of teamwork and performance.  



Interested in joining a company with a strong sense of community?  



We’re growing. We’re hiring. We encourage. We empower. We support.  

\#winningtogether \#peoplematter

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.

 AI Agents \& Workflow Integration

 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
   

  

**Minimum 18 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 As an Technical Architect in AI Infrastructure Architecture, you will act as a senior technical authority for AWS\-based AI/ML compute infrastructure, shaping the technical vision, reference architecture, standards and implementation strategy for large\-scale AI systems. You will evaluate complex choices across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security and cost optimization, while guiding senior and lead architects/Technical Architects to deliver resilient, scalable and production\-ready AI infrastructure. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, compliance, reliability, FinOps and platform modernization to help clients translate AI infrastructure trade\-offs into measurable business value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Set the overarching AWS AI infrastructure vision, strategy and reference architecture for large\-scale AI/ML systems, including compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving and observability.
   

  

 Own complex architectural decisions across AWS services such as EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, FSx/EFS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch and related DevOps/security tooling, rationalizing options against client standards and business objectives.
   

  

 Architect and prototype cost\-optimized GPU/accelerated compute and distributed training environments, building benchmarks, proof\-of\-concepts and reusable implementation patterns.
   

  

 Define architecture standards, reusable infrastructure\-as\-code patterns, CI/CD approaches, model deployment patterns, monitoring strategy, SLAs/SLOs and cost/performance governance for production AI/ML systems.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and design reviews validate findings through hands\-on implementation, profiling, performance tuning and troubleshooting across the AI infrastructure stack.
   

  

 Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, accelerators, interconnects, managed AI services and ecosystem tools, and recommend where they belong in enterprise solutions.
   

  

 Provide executive and client\-level technical advisory, translating cloud infrastructure trade\-offs into clear, defensible recommendations connected to business outcomes.
   

  

 Mentor architects and Technical Architects, build community best practices and represent the practice in internal and external technical forums.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Technical Architecting, Information Technology or a related Technical Architecting field.
   

  

 Minimum 6 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale Technical Architecting solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the compute, infrastructure, orchestration and deployment foundations required to run production AI systems.
   

  

 Minimum 6 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent Technical Architecting languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI infrastructure projects and teams, including technical direction, design reviews, delivery governance and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

 Strong project management, communication, problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration skills in fast\-paced client or enterprise environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, reference architectures and platform services for production solutions.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Expert\-level hands\-on architecture experience with AWS AI infrastructure services including EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch and automation/DevOps services.
   

  

 Deep knowledge of GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, container platforms, storage design, network design, observability and resilience Technical Architecting.
   

  

 Strong experience with Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, security guardrails, monitoring and infrastructure cost optimization.
   

  

 Ability to evaluate multiple AWS architecture options and produce standards, patterns, decision records, benchmarks and executive\-ready recommendations.
   

  

 Experience applying MLOps/InfraOps practices for experiment tracking, model registry, deployment automation, monitoring, incident response and rollback strategies.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Technical Architect Professional or Machine Learning specialty/associate credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience designing AI infrastructure for BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments with compliance, security and reliability constraints.
   

  

 Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, model optimization, high\-performance storage and low\-latency model serving.
   

  

 Experience with enterprise architecture governance, technology roadmaps, vendor/partner management, FinOps and production support operating models.

2c1e1efb.title: Principal IT Solution Architect
2c1e1efb.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------


Are you looking for an exciting new chance to build on your experience working on business\-led change initiatives? Arm is changing the future of computing across multiple sectors from mobile clients and automotive through to Hyperscalers and embedded devices. And we're doing this together with our broad ecosystem of partners and for the benefit of everyone!
You will be part of Arm’s Enterprise IT Business Applications Architecture practice and work across the portfolio of projects to provide architectural guidance and solutions to business challenges that are aligned to strategy and EIT roadmaps. You will also be responsible for technical leadership and direction to development and delivery teams, ensuring delivery of your designs is adequately stewarded and also collaborating across teams to find opportunities for new technologies.
**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


**Interpret Business Needs**
* Collaborate with senior leaders to identify future technology innovations and evolutions that have potential to address business ambitions
* Develop solutions designs (HLD) and roadmaps aligned to the Domain target
* Maintain mapping between Capabilities, Applications and Data

**Assess and Apply Technology**
-------------------------------


* Be creative in the use of existing technologies
* Work with members of the technical communities to develop and establish reference patterns for Platforms and Solutions
* Look ahead for opportunities with new technologies and applications

**Technical leadership**
------------------------


* Supports change initiatives and technical communities, guiding and helping teams and partners to align with the overall enterprise architecture
* Ownership of solution pattern and approach, responsible for sign\-off on High\-Level designs and ensuring alignment to target and roadmaps
* Ensure quality of Architecture design artefacts and present at governance forums

**Practice Development**
------------------------


* Develop and evolve Architecture principles, governance, materials and ways of working
* Guide and mentor teams on architecture principles, governance, and standard practices
* Drive innovation by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that align with business needs

**Required Skills and Experience:**
-----------------------------------


* At least 8 years of experience in a Solution Architect role.
* Strong experience with Salesforce, SAP, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, event\-driven architectures, MS Power Platform, Automation Anywhere).
* Good knowledge of LoB applications (e.g., ServiceNow, HCM, CMS, CLM) in commercial and operational domains.
* Expertise in cloud services (multi\-provider, AI, cloud\-native development).
* Experience with DevSecOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.
* Ability to balance long\-term vision with short\-term needs and define multiple solution options.
* Familiarity with Business Analysis, Programme Management, and application development methodologies.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies
* Demonstrable experience in project governance, leadership, and architecture team development.

**“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:**
-----------------------------------------


* Formal qualifications in development languages or application platforms
* Experience of the semi\-conductor industry or other Engineering based organisations!

**In Return:**
--------------


* This is a new team, and there is plenty of opportunity to shape its future, and your own growth and progression.

**Our 10x Mindset**
-------------------


At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x\-mindset


**Use of AI in Your Application**
---------------------------------


At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI\-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.


**Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations**
----------------------------------------------


At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.


**Hybrid Working**
------------------


Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.


**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

2f0e70d1.title: Operations and Delivery Manager
2f0e70d1.description:
Operations \& Delivery Manager — Dharwad Dada
 
**Location:** 
 Dharwad, Karnataka
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Food, FMCG, D2C and E\-commerce
 



**Travel:** 
 Regular local travel across Dharwad–Hubballi
 



**Preferred Joining:** 
 Immediate or early joiners
 


 About Dharwad Dada
 
 Dharwad Dada is building a premium D2C brand around Dharwad’s famous pedha. Our promise is simple: authentic taste, premium packaging and reliable delivery—so customers across India can experience
 **“The Peda That Melts in Your Mouth.”** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Operations \& Delivery Manager** 
 to manage the complete journey from pedha preparation to final dispatch.
 


 Role Overview
 
 This is a field\-oriented operations role—not a desk\-only position.
 



 You will coordinate closely with our pedha makers, packaging team, suppliers and delivery partners to ensure every order is prepared, packed and shipped correctly and on time.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong local knowledge of Dharwad–Hubballi, be comfortable working directly with traditional sweet makers and take complete ownership of quality and daily dispatch operations.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Coordination
 * Coordinate daily production requirements with pedha makers.
* Communicate expected order quantities and dispatch deadlines.
* Ensure pedhas are prepared according to agreed taste, quality, hygiene and consistency standards.
* Monitor batch readiness and resolve production delays.
* Maintain simple daily production and wastage records.


 Quality and Hygiene
 * Inspect pedhas before packing for freshness, appearance, weight and consistency.
* Ensure safe food\-handling and hygiene practices are followed.
* Identify damaged, inconsistent or unsuitable products before dispatch.
* Coordinate corrective action with the production team.
* Help establish repeatable quality\-control checklists.


 Packaging Operations
 * Train and supervise workers on the approved packaging process.
* Ensure every box contains the correct number of individually packed pedhas.
* Verify seals, wrappers, labels, batch information and final presentation.
* Ensure shipping cartons provide adequate protection during transit.
* Monitor the availability of boxes, wrappers, labels and other packaging materials.
* Prevent incorrect, damaged or incomplete orders from being shipped.


 Order Fulfilment and Dispatch
 * Review daily orders and prepare an accurate dispatch plan.
* Match every package with the correct customer and delivery details.
* Coordinate pickups with Delhivery and other logistics partners.
* Ensure orders are handed over within the promised timeline.
* Record AWB and tracking details accurately.
* Follow up on delayed pickups, undelivered shipments, returns and damaged parcels.


 Inventory and Vendor Coordination
 * Maintain stock records for pedhas, packaging materials and complimentary products.
* Estimate upcoming material requirements and prevent stock shortages.
* Coordinate with packaging vendors and other local suppliers.
* Track wastage, damages and operational discrepancies.
* Help control fulfilment and delivery costs without compromising quality.


 Reporting and Improvement
 * Provide a daily update covering production, packing, dispatches, delays and issues.
* Track order accuracy, on\-time dispatch, damages, returns and wastage.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements.
* Build reliable processes that can support increasing daily order volumes.


 Candidate Requirements
 * 2–6 years of experience in operations, fulfilment, logistics, food production, FMCG, retail, warehouse management or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with Dharwad and Hubballi.
* Candidates currently residing in or having strong roots and working knowledge of the Dharwad–Hubballi region will be preferred.
* Willingness to travel regularly within Dharwad and nearby areas.
* Comfortable working directly with sweet makers, packers, suppliers and delivery personnel.
* Ability to train workers and enforce packaging and quality standards.
* Strong ownership, discipline and problem\-solving ability.
* Basic working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable using order dashboards, courier portals, WhatsApp and email.
* Ability to communicate effectively in Kannada; working knowledge of Hindi and English is preferred.
* Two\-wheeler and a valid driving licence are strongly preferred.


 What Success Looks Like
 * Orders are prepared and dispatched on time.
* Every box meets the approved quality and packaging standards.
* Order errors, damage, wastage and delays remain minimal.
* Packaging materials are always available when required.
* Courier pickups and tracking updates happen reliably.
* Production and fulfilment can scale without compromising the customer experience.


 Who Should Apply?
 
 You may be a strong fit if you:
 


* Know the Dharwad–Hubballi area well.
* Enjoy fieldwork and hands\-on operational responsibility.
* Can work respectfully with traditional food makers while implementing professional standards.
* Notice small quality and packaging issues before customers do.
* Take personal ownership of getting every order shipped properly and on time.


 How to Apply
 
 Apply through LinkedIn or Naukri with your updated résumé.
 



 Please include the following in your application:
 


* Current location
* Relevant operations or logistics experience
* Current and expected compensation
* Notice period
* Availability for regular local travel
* Whether you own a two\-wheeler
* Languages spoken
* **Subject/Headline:** 
 Application — Operations \& Delivery Manager, Dharwad Dada

91345011.title: Technical Program Manager
91345011.description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a technically fluent program leader who ensures problems are deeply understood before they are resolved.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Technical Program Manager owns Armor’s problem\-management program and the analytical work that drives down the volume of issues customers experience. This is a program and analysis role, not a day\-to\-day ticket\-resolution role: rather than working individual customer tickets, the Technical Program Manager digs into the data behind them to find the systemic problems that generate recurring work, and drives those to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework. That work is grounded in understanding how data flows into Armor’s systems—the connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines behind platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender—so root causes and data\-quality issues can be identified, not guessed. The role partners closely with Engineering, SRE, and support delivery teams and thinks in terms of measurable, repeatable outcomes rather than one\-off fixes—an approach that matters deeply for a cybersecurity company where recurring problems carry real customer risk. Based in Pune, India, the role works primarily on India business hours and carries the flexibility to overlap with US Central hours as needed to collaborate with Armor’s Dallas\-based Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams. It reports to and takes strategic direction from the Head of Global Support.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Analyze incident and ticket data toidentifythe systemic drivers of ticket volume, and target measurable reductions in recurring work and customer\-impacting incidents.
* Investigate how data flows into Armor’s systems—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Qualys/VMDR, log/SIEM sources, and Azure and cloud telemetry—to surface data\-quality issues and the root causes behind recurring problems.
* Work through ambiguity: develop hypotheses about recurring and systemic prob lems, valid ate root cause with data, and ensure problems are genuinely understood before solutions are pursued.
* Consolidaterecurring incidents and service requests into managed problem recordsand drive them to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework—without taking over day\-to\-day ticket execution, which is owned by dedicated delivery teams.
* Build the queries, dashboards, and reports that surface trends and quantify customer and business impact (e.g., KQL over Sentinel/Defender, SQL, Power BI, and Jira reporting).
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring problems; document root causes, workarounds, and known errors so delivery teams resolve recurrences consistently.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams to land systemic fixes, and coordinate permanent fixes that require change through Armor’s change process.
* Define and report the metrics that matter—reduction in recurring customer\-impacting incidents and ticket volume as the headline, with operational signals (recurring\-problem count, MTTR, RCA compliance, and SLA adherence) as supporting measures.
* Run problem\-review cadences,maintainand drive down a prioritized problem backl og, and t rack held known errors so workarounds do not quietly become permanent technical debt.
* Identifyautomation and process\-improvement opportunities and program\-manage their delivery to reduce manual, repetitive work.
* Maintain authoritative documentation and a known\-error knowledge base in Confluence, and provide clear, executive\-level status, risks, and escalations.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\-12years of experience in technical program management, security or IT operations, data and analytics, or service/problem management; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Scienc e , Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional programs and drive outcomes across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Hands\-on data analysis: able to query operational and security data using KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Defender) and SQL, and to build reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Jira) that surface trends and quantify impact.
* Working understanding of data integrations—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines—and how security telemetry reaches a SIEM or analytics platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender).
* Solid grounding in problem management and root cause analysis, aligned to ITIL (Problem, Incident, and Service Management).
* Familiarity (conceptual, not hands\-on delivery) with the security domains Armor operates: vulnerability management (Qualys/VMDR), endpoint and EDR (Microsoft Defender), and cloud and identity (Azure, Okta/Entra).
* Ability to read incident and ticket data and translate it into prioritized, measurable action.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management in English, including executive\-level reporting and clear RCAs and resolution frameworks.
* Proficiencywith Jira and Confluence.
* Strategic, systemic thinker with a bias for repeatable, automation\-assisted solutions over one\-off fixes.
* Self\-directed, taking strategic direction and prioritization from the Head of Support.


 Alignment to Armor Core Values
   

  

* COMMITMENT TO GROWTH
* INTEGRITY ALWAYS
* EMPATHY IN ACTION
* IMMEDIATE IMPACT
* FOLLOW\-THROUGH


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Depth in KQL/Kusto, Power BI, or Power Automate, or exposure to data engineering and pipeline troubleshooting.
* Experience building or troubleshooting API\-based integrations and data connectors.
* PMP, ITIL v4, or Microsoft security/Azure certifications.
* Experience in a cybersecurity or managed\-security services (MSSP) environment.


 WORK ENVIRONMENT
   

  

 This role is based in Armor’s Pune, India office and works primarily on India business hours. Because sev eral p artner teams are based in Dallas, the role calls for flexibility to shift part of the working day into US Central time as needed to collaborate with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams and to run problem reviews and escalations. As a program role rather than a customer\-facing ticket role, it does not require continuous late\-night coverage; the emphasis is on dependable overlap and responsiveness. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate, and the environment may be an office setting, the company’s data center , or remote. Occasional extended or off\-hours work may be required during major incidents.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer \- It is the policy of the company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color , religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

7dc76c4b.title: Solutions Architect- IP
7dc76c4b.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who We Hire — The DNA**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.


 No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast.
   

  

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly.
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard.
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow.
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it.
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring;**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

a3ece2e8.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

e03f0391.title: Architect
e03f0391.description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to lead the design and architecture of a next\-generation LC\-MS multiplexing platform for analytical instrumentation. The role involves defining real\-time, multi\-instrument orchestration systems that integrate instrument control software, device drivers, scheduling engines, and regulated data management solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in C\+\+, .NET, device communication protocols, real\-time systems, and analytical instrument platforms, with a proven track record of building scalable, reliable, and compliance\-ready software solutions in regulated environments.
 



  




* **Role: Architect**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 12\+ Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* As a Solution Architect, you will lead the design and development of advanced instrument orchestration platforms that enable real\-time coordination between multiple analytical instruments while ensuring performance, reliability, and regulatory compliance. Based on and related architecture documents. Define end\-to\-end architecture for multi\-instrument orchestration and LC\-MS multiplexing platforms.
* Design scalable, modular, deterministic, and high\-performance software systems for instrument control.
* Architect and guide development using C\+\+, .NET/C\#, and modern software engineering practices.
* Develop hardware abstraction layers (HAL) to support HPLC systems, mass spectrometers, valves, and peripheral devices.
* Lead device driver and communication framework development across USB, Ethernet, Serial (RS232/RS485\), and CAN interfaces.
* Design real\-time scheduling engines, workflow orchestration, and event\-driven architectures for timing\-critical operations.
* Establish low\-latency communication mechanisms and synchronization across multiple instruments and devices.
* Ensure data integrity, auditability, electronic records management, and compliance with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 standards.
* Architect fault\-tolerant systems with robust error handling, recovery workflows, and device failure management.
* Collaborate closely with product management, firmware, hardware, and software engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions.
* Mentor senior engineers, conduct architecture reviews, and drive technical standards, best practices, and design governance.
* Drive technical decision\-making throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through deployment and validation



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* We are seeking a highly experienced Solution Architect with deep expertise in instrument control software, real\-time orchestration systems, device communication, and regulated software environments.
* The ideal candidate will bring strong technical leadership, system architecture capabilities, and hands\-on experience building end\-to\-end hardware\-software integrated platforms.
* 12\-18\+ years of experience in software architecture, instrument software development, or technical leadership roles.
* Strong expertise in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11/14/17\) for instrument control, device communication, and real\-time systems development.
* Hands\-on experience with C\#/.NET, WPF, or modern UI frameworks for orchestration, workflow management, and enterprise applications.
* Proven experience designing scalable, modular, distributed, and real\-time software architecture.
* Strong understanding of multi\-threading, concurrent programming, synchronization, and performance optimization.
* Experience developing instrument control software, hardware abstraction layers (HAL), and device communication frameworks.
* Expertise in communication protocols including TCP/IP, USB, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, CAN, and related device interfaces.
* Solid knowledge of event\-driven architecture, state machines, workflow orchestration, and scheduling algorithms.
* Experience designing fault\-tolerant, reliable systems with recovery mechanisms and error\-handling strategies.
* Knowledge of GxP\-regulated environments, 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, audit trails, electronic records, and software validation practices.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills across hardware and software layers
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring abilities, with experience leading senior engineering teams.
* Preferred experience in analytical instrumentation, laboratory automation, chromatography, LC\-MS, HPLC, GC, medical devices, or industrial automation domains.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electronics \& Telecommunication, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Advanced degrees (M.Tech/MS) in Software Systems, Embedded Systems, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Computer Engineering are preferred.
* Relevant certifications in Software Architecture, System Design, Embedded Systems, or Cloud Technologies will be an added advantage.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents



  





**Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:** 




  





 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
 



  




* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment



  





**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent \-** 
**persistent.com/careers** 




  





**"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."**
