688f9320.title: Solution Architect, IT/ITES Vertical
688f9320.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.  

  

Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.  

  

In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.  

  

You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.  

  

Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!  

\#aws\-ags\-India  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.

  

A day in the life  

Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!  

  

As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Engagement Manager – Organic Growth (SEO \& GEO) will lead strategic organic growth engagements for enterprise clients, helping them maximize visibility, customer acquisition, and business outcomes across both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-powered discovery platforms.

* Emerging AI\-powered discovery platforms

* Collaborate with content, analytics, and data science teams to create AI\-ready content and scalable search frameworks.

* Conduct SEO/GEO audits and prioritize recommendations based on business impact and implementation effort.
* Present findings, recommendations, and growth opportunities to executive stakeholders.

**Program \& Delivery Management**


* Own end\-to\-end management of organic growth engagements from strategy through execution and measurement.
* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising SEO specialists, content strategists, developers, UX teams, analytics resources, and data scientists.
* Drive implementation of recommendations and ensure timely delivery against agreed roadmaps.
* Monitor project health, identify risks, and proactively manage stakeholder expectations. Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes including traffic growth, AI search visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue impact.
* Manage client escalations and drive resolution in partnership with delivery teams.

**Commercial \& Account Management**


* Drive client satisfaction, retention, and long\-term account health.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, upsell, and cross\-sell of iQuanti capabilities.
* Support proposal development, solutioning discussions, and growth initiatives. Ensure scope, priorities, and client expectations remain aligned throughout the engagement.
* Partner with internal teams to maintain strong delivery quality and commercial performance.

**Team Leadership**


* Mentor and guide SEO specialists, analysts, and consultants.
* Foster a culture of analytical rigor, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Share best practices across teams and contribute to capability development.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development initiatives

**Who You Are**


* 8–12\+ years of experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Digital Marketing Consulting, or related fields.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience managing enterprise SEO programs for large websites.
* Strong expertise in Technical SEO, Content Strategy \& Optimization, Site Architecture, Keyword Research, Core Web Vitals, Indexation \& Crawl Optimization, International SEO, and BFSI/E\-commerce SEO.
* Experience managing client\-facing SEO engagements and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience leading cross\-functional teams and mentoring junior team members.

**Preferred Experience**


* Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI\-powered search ecosystems.
* Understanding of Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI search experiences.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for SEO analysis, content optimization, workflow automation, and insight generation.
* Familiarity with entity\-based search, semantic search, and knowledge graph optimization.
* Experience working with enterprise clients in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, or E\-commerce sectors.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Marketing, or related field.

**Success Measures**

* Successful adoption of SEO and GEO best practices across client engagements.
* Increased account growth through expansion opportunities.

Beyond campaign strategy, management, and optimization, we engage with clients to understand their business and produce proprietary insights that lead to stronger business results.


Through a data science\-led approach to client problem\-solving, we've created a differentiated suite of product\-driven service offerings that we deploy to clients, including a search\-predictive efficacy platform called ALPS. We're 350\+ people strong worldwide, with hubs in Jersey City and Bangalore.

 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This is a global role requiring close collaboration across multiple regions and continents. The DCIM Delivery Manager coordinates multidisciplinary activities associated with the AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara Centers of Excellence, supporting pre‑commissioning and commissioning activities for Equinix critical infrastructure construction projects worldwide.
   

  

 The role is accountable for delivering DCIM and DCOS outcomes to operations at Ready for Service (RFS), ensuring solutions are implemented in line with Equinix global standards, with a strong focus on quality, consistency, and operational readiness.

* Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting assistance to the global DCOS Delivery team


 DCIM Integration \& Onboarding
   

  

* Develop and approve Data Center SmartView electrical hierarchies for DCIM onboarding
* Coordinate with DCOS System Integrators to:
+ Perform initial DCOS\-to\-DCIM asset synchronisation and review outcomes
+ Enable and validate data collection within DCIM
+ Conduct structured data sanity checks to ensure accuracy and completeness


 Validation \& Assurance
   

  

* Validate DCIM alarms in collaboration with site teams, System Integrators, and PSAE/Onboarding teams
* Verify WWDCIM integration configurations, ensuring all points are correctly mapped, and that system\-level calculations (including resiliency, utility power, and PUE) are accurate
* Confirm that Battery Monitoring Systems and Branch Circuit Monitoring (BCM) systems are fully operational prior to DCIM onboarding


 Project \& Commissioning Support
   

  

* Provide clear and structured briefings to stakeholders on DCIM prerequisites, commissioning requirements, and go‑live checklists from project initiation through completion
* Actively participate in DCIM commissioning activities, ensuring alignment with Equinix Global Standards and commissioning best practices
* Collaborate with DCOS DCIM Managers, Global Managers, and Regional Managers to ensure commissioning documentation meets both industry standards and Equinix requirements


 Tracking, Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Manage internal tools to track delivery progress against defined milestones
* Produce program‑level reporting, analytics, and performance metrics for stakeholders
* Maintain, continuously improve, and standardise DCIM commissioning procedures and standards
* Drive specification uplift initiatives related to General Commissioning where DCIM is in scope
* Track, report, and communicate DCIM delivery status across all assigned projects


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in data centre controls and automation, construction, operations, or facilities maintenance
* Strong engineering background within mission‑critical environments such as data centres, power generation, or oil \& gas facilities
* Demonstrated ability to research, evaluate, and apply new technologies, designs, and construction methodologies for critical infrastructure
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with structured data tools such as databases and reporting platforms
* Solid understanding of electrical, mechanical, and monitoring systems supporting critical infrastructure
* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast‑paced, global delivery environment
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience coordinating across cross‑functional and geographically distributed teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality outcomes under tight timelines


 This role is critical to ensuring DCIM and DCOS solutions are delivered to operations with zero open defects at RFS, supporting Equinix’s commitment to operational excellence and global consistency.

**About Nuaav** 




 Nuaav is a boutique consulting firm dedicated to being a strategic partner for corporate leaders. We deliver impactful business results through specialized, high\-touch technology solutions designed for rapidly evolving environments. Our expertise spans product engineering, data systems, AI/ML, and UX, combining innovation, agility, and deep domain knowledge to empower clients with scalable, secure, and future\-proof solutions. * Drive program roadmaps, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Establish program governance, operating rhythms, status reporting, and execution frameworks.
* Manage risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery.
* Partner with leadership teams to provide visibility into program health, progress, and outcomes.
* Drive alignment across multiple teams, functions, and stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, execution efficiency, and delivery outcomes.



**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, QA, Data teams, and Business stakeholders.
* Translate business priorities into clear execution plans for technical teams.
* Facilitate discussions between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure teams have clarity on priorities, scope, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Support executive communication through clear reporting and program insights.



**Technical Understanding (Engineering Partnership – 20%)** 



* Partner with engineering teams working on:
* Data engineering platforms
* ETL/data transformation pipelines
* Backend systems
* Cloud\-based technology solutions
* Understand technical concepts including:
* Python and PySpark\-based data processing
* Data pipelines and system integrations
* Cloud data environments (AWS/GCP/Azure)
* Software development lifecycle and engineering practices
* Support technical decision\-making by facilitating discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring alignment with program goals.
* Understand data governance, security, compliance, and operational considerations in cloud environments.



**Engineering Team Enablement** 



* Partner with Engineering Managers to improve delivery execution and team effectiveness.
* Support engineering teams with planning, prioritization, and removal of execution blockers.
* Encourage Agile practices, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration.
* Provide mentorship and guidance on program execution practices.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of experience in technology program management, technical project management, software delivery, or engineering operations.
* Proven experience managing complex technology programs involving multiple teams.
* Strong experience working with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Experience driving delivery in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced technology environment.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Strong program management and execution discipline.
* Experience managing technology transformation programs.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and technical teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience improving engineering delivery processes and operational excellence.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 A technology\-focused program leader who can drive execution, align cross\-functional teams, manage complex engineering initiatives, and ensure predictable delivery while having enough technical depth to partner effectively with engineering teams.
 



**Why Join Nuaav?** 



* Opportunity to work in a strong AI driven consulting firm with direct client engagement and high\-impact projects.
* Be part of a dynamic environment focused on innovation, agility, and quality over volume.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies across data engineering, AI, and product platforms.

**Location \-Noida / Remote / Hybrid**

 Location: Mumbai (FOGSI Headquarters)
 



  





 About FOGSI: The Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI) is one of the largest professional bodies of doctors in India, representing over 45,000 obstetricians and gynaecologists across the country. FOGSI plays a key role in advancing women’s health and shaping clinical practice, policy, and training in maternal and newborn health. Role Overview FOGSI, in collaboration with Koita Foundation (KF), has established a Digital Health Centre to accelerate digital health adoption in maternal and newborn health.
 



  





 As a Senior Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving the implementation of FOGSI’s Digital Health Strategy and managing the day\-to\-day operations of the FOGSI\-Koita Centre for Digital Maternal and Child Care (FOGSI\-KCDM). You will work closely with doctors across India, partner organizations, and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of digital health initiatives that strengthen maternal and newborn care. The role will involve program design, stakeholder coordination, and implementation support across initiatives such as digital health adoption, EMR enablement, AI\-enabled solutions, capacity building, and ecosystem development for FOGSI members.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  Lead and manage FOGSI\-KCDM initiatives in collaboration with doctors, hospitals, state chapters, and external partners.
 



  Oversee the execution of FOGSI\-KCDM roadmap, including solution benchmarking, and training programs, solution benchmarking, and innovation pilots.
 



  Build and maintain partnerships with digital health solution providers, government agencies, academic institutions, and healthcare organizations.
 



  Coordinate implementation of pilot projects with FOGSI members to demonstrate adoption and impact of digital health and AI\-enabled solutions in OB\-GYN practice.
 



  Develop and roll out capacity\-building programs for practitioners, including workshops, CME sessions, and digital training modules.
 



  Monitor progress and adoption metrics, analyze outcomes, and prepare reports for FOGSI leadership and partners.
 



  Represent FOGSI\-KCDM in external forums, conferences, and consultations.
 



  Support fundraising and resource mobilization efforts where required.
 



  





**Desired Profile** 




  A professional with 8–10 years of overall experience, including at least 4 years in healthcare /digital health/public health program management.
 



  Strong motivation to work in the healthcare/nonprofit sector with senior clinicians and professional bodies.
 



  Master’s degree in public health, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or Business Administration preferred.
 



  Experience with provider\-facing digital health initiatives, healthcare technology adoption programs, or digital transformation projects is highly preferred.
 



  Experience with maternal and newborn health programs will help.
 



  





**Skills and Attributes** 




  Demonstrated experience in project management or related roles, preferably in healthcare, Digital Health tools and technologies, or healthcare\-focused nonprofit organizations.
 



  Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
 



  Experience in crafting detailed reports, presentations, and stakeholder communication.
 



  Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
 



  Preferred \- Familiarity with technologies relevant to digital health, such as HIS/EMR solutions, telemedicine, etc.

 Salesforce Ecosystem:

* AI/ML model usage \& LLM\-based solutioning.

* Create margin analysis, cost breakdowns, and pricing models.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery leadership for approvals and validation.

* Convert customer requirements into compelling technical narratives and business value propositions.
* Document design assumptions, architectural decisions, and solution trade\-offs.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, and performance standards.


**What you will bring:**

**What we offer:**

a57e77ce.title: Senior SAP Warehouse & Logistics Architect T6
a57e77ce.description:
Tasks



Job Description


Key Responsibilities


Solution Architecture* Define end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA solution architecture for Supply Chain, Logistics, and Compliance processes.
* Design scalable and integrated solutions across MM, EWM, TM, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Sales.
* Ensure adherence to SAP best practices, Clean Core principles, and SAP Activate methodology.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance, and design approvals.

  

SAP Material Management* Configure and support Purchase Order (PO) processing in SAP S/4HANA.
* Manage Supplier Master processes, including supplier creation, maintenance, and suppression/blocking activities.
* Support Goods Movement processes, including Goods Receipt (GR), Goods Issue (GI), stock transfers, and transfer postings.
* Configure and support Inventory Management, including stock monitoring, inventory adjustments, physical inventory, and stock reconciliation.
* Manage Purchase Pricing, including pricing procedures, condition records, contracts, scheduling agreements, and source determination.
* Support ARM (Advanced Returns Management) supplier return processes, including return orders, return deliveries, inspection, and supplier credit handling.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and implement SAP MM solutions.
* Analyze and resolve production support issues while ensuring system stability.
* Work with cross\-functional teams, including SAP SD, EWM, FI, and TM, for end\-to\-end process integration.


SAP EWM / Decentralized EWM (dEWM)* Configure and support Inbound Warehouse Processes, including:
	+ Deconsolidation
	+ Putaway
	+ Exception handling during inbound processing
	+ Cross Docking (IL03\)
* Configure and support Outbound Warehouse Processes, including:
	+ Picking
	+ Packing
	+ Pick Denial and exception handling
	+ Goods Issue processing
* Support Physical Inventory processes, including cycle counting, annual inventory, recounts, and inventory adjustments.
* Analyze warehouse process issues and provide functional solutions.
* Work closely with business users to gather requirements and improve warehouse operations.
* Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and production support.
* Collaborate with SAP MM, SD, TM, and other integrated modules to ensure seamless end\-to\-end warehouse processes.
* Architect warehouse management solutions covering:
	+ Warehouse storage
	+ Inventory management
	+ Internal warehouse movements
	+ Physical inventory
	+ Customs and bonded warehouse processes
* Design RF, barcode scanning, automation, and warehouse integration scenarios.
* Define warehouse structure, storage types, process\-oriented storage control, and labor management where applicable.

  

SAP Transportation Management (TM)* Lead architecture for transportation planning and logistics execution.
* Configure and support Advanced Shipping and Receiving (ASR) processes integrated with SAP TM and EWM.
* Configure and support Transport Execution (Outbound) processes from shipment planning through delivery execution.
* Support Transportation Planning, including freight unit building, carrier selection, load planning, route planning, and transportation scheduling.
* Manage Transportation Execution, including freight order management, shipment tracking, status updates, and proof of delivery.
* Configure and support Freight Management, including freight agreements, charge calculation, freight settlement, and carrier invoicing.
* Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and optimize transportation processes.
* Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and production support.
* Work with SAP EWM, MM, SD, and other integrated modules to ensure seamless end\-to\-end logistics processes.
* Ensure direct engagement with project teams for issue resolution (not tool\-driven escalation).

  


Good To Have
SAP Product Compliance* Design and implement Product Compliance processes within SAP S/4HANA.
* Lead solution design for:


	+ Quality inspection processes
	+ PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) sampling
	+ Dangerous goods management
	+ Hazardous substance compliance
	+ Product safety and regulatory compliance
* Integrate Product Compliance with Quality Management (QM), Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), and EWM.
* Ensure compliance with regional and global regulatory requirements.

  

Integration \& Technical Leadership* Define integration architecture across SAP modules and non\-SAP systems.
* Collaborate with Integration, BTP, API, and middleware teams.
* Lead Fit\-to\-Standard workshops and solution blueprint sessions.
* Provide technical guidance during development, testing, cutover, and hypercare.
* Review functional specifications, technical designs, and custom developments.

  

Stakeholder Management* Partner with business process owners and global stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Present architecture recommendations to leadership and governance boards.
* Mentor functional consultants and solution designers.

  

Required* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 12–14\+ years of SAP experience.
* 8\+ years of SAP Solution Architecture experience.
* Multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Strong knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience leading global SAP transformation programs.

* Drive architecture decisions aligned with enterprise standards, security requirements, governance frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Establish reusable data models, semantic layers, and KPI frameworks.
* Define integration patterns across S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, Datasphere, SAC, BigQuery, and other enterprise platforms.

* Lead end\-to\-end programme delivery from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.

* Ensure delivery quality, budget adherence, timeline management, and achievement of project KPIs.
* Manage risks, dependencies, escalations, and resource planning activities.

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into effective analytics solutions.
* Facilitate workshops, requirements\-gathering activities, and solution review sessions.
* Present solution architectures, roadmaps, delivery progress, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
* Build collaborative relationships across business and technology teams.

* Define and maintain development standards, naming conventions, transport processes, and data governance practices.
* Establish performance optimisation frameworks across Datasphere, BW/4HANA, and SAC.
* Promote SAP best practices for data modelling, security, lifecycle management, and platform governance.
* Ensure solution documentation, audit readiness, and operational support frameworks are maintained.

### **Service Management**

* Lead incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Ensure alignment with service level commitments and continuous improvement objectives.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions to improve platform stability and performance.

---------------


7\+ years of overall professional experience.5\+ years of experience in solution architecture and delivery leadership roles.Proven experience leading large\-scale SAP Analytics implementations and support engagements.Strong expertise in SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP BW/4HANA.Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, integration, and analytics platforms.Experience designing solutions across SAP and non\-SAP technology landscapes.Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.Excellent stakeholder management, communication, workshop facilitation, and presentation skills.Ability to balance technical governance, strategic planning, and delivery execution within complex enterprise environments.**Not a perfect fit?**

b0150575.description:
**Who Are We?** 





 Millipixels Interactive
 
  is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build
 



 meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation\-driven technology solutions.
 



  





 But beyond the work, we’re a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution.
 



 We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.
 



  





 If you’re someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact \- you’ll probably
 



 enjoy being here.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every strong proposal has a moment where sales promise meet technical reality and someone has to
 



 make sure those two things actually match. At Millipixels, that's you.
 



  





 You'll own the entire technical pre\-sales journey: running discovery workshops that uncover what clients actually need, architecting solutions that hold up under real\-world conditions, and standing in front of clients to present, demo, and defend what Millipixels can build. You're the bridge between business development and delivery making sure nothing gets sold that can't be built, and nothing gets built that wasn't sold right.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial instinct. You'll need to go deep
 



 enough into AI and tech solutioning to earn a room full of engineers' respect, while staying sharp
 



 enough on commercial viability to keep a deal moving forward.
 



  





**You’ll Be the Person Who** 




 • Leads Discovery That Actually Uncovers Something: Runs workshops that go beyond surface requirements to understand what clients really need and what they haven't said out loud yet.
 



 • Architects Solutions That Hold Up: Designs technical solutions that are robust enough to survive
 



 delivery, not just impressive enough to survive a pitch.
 



 • Owns the Client\-Facing Moment: Presents, demos, and fields tough technical questions in real
 



 time turning complexity into clarity for the people across the table.
 



 • Bridges Sales and Delivery: Makes sure what gets promised in a proposal is exactly what
 



 delivery can and will build.• Stress\-Tests Every Proposal: Ensures each solution is commercially viable, technically sound, and operationally realistic before it ever reaches a client's inbox.
 



 • Speaks Fluent AI: Understands AI solutions deeply enough to shape them, question them, and
 



 explain them not just reference them.
 



 • Solves in Real Time: Handles technical clarifications and objections on the spot, without needing
 



 to "get back to you."
 



 • Keeps Solutions Aligned to Reality: Ensures every proposed solution actually reflects what
 



 Millipixels can deliver not just what sounds good on paper.
 



 • Shapes the Proposal, Not Just Reviews It: Gets involved early in proposal solutioning, so
 



 technical thinking is baked in from the start, not bolted on at the end.
 



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 




 • You come from a hardcore tech solutioning background hands\-on, not just adjacent to it.
 



 • You have strong working knowledge of AI solutions and can architect around them, not just talk about them.
 



 • You've operated in technical pre\-sales, solution architecture, or a similar client\-facing technical role.
 



 • You have excellent communication skills; fluent enough with engineering heads to discuss what gets built and how, yet just as at ease making deep tech solutions digestible to non\-technical stakeholders
 



 • You're equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with engineers and a boardroom pitch with executives.
 



 • You can translate deep technical detail into a language that lands with non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • You think commercially, you know a great solution still has to make business sense.
 



  





**Benefits of Working at Millipixels** 




 • Flexible work, your way: Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
 



 • Life admin handled: Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn’t eat into your weekends.
 



 • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Company\-paid health insurance of ₹500,000, with options to extend to spouse.
 



 • Generous paid leave: Properly switch off and recharge. We’re in this for the long game, and so are you.
 



 • Room to grow: Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to grow your career as fast as you grow the pipeline.• Ground\-floor impact: Join early, help shape the GTM playbook, and put your mark on how we grow, including our AI platform, avirat.ai.
 



 • Ownership, not red tape: Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

This individual will also cross\-train in Shield AI’s other products to support integrated solution discussions.

* Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.

* Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.
* Support competitive analysis and market intelligence specific to the Indian tactical aircraft market, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.
* Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.

* Strong systems\-level understanding of aircraft design tradeoffs, operational CONOPS, and mission\-based engineering.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Background in autonomy, AI\-driven systems, or networked ISR.
* Experience contributing to early\-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.
* Prior military service experience (Indian or allied forces).
* Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business.
* 5\+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role 3\+ years of experience working in a startup environment.

 **I****nsight at a Glance**

* 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
* Received 35\+ industry and partner awards in the past year
* $9\.2 billion in revenue
* \#20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list
* \#14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

 **About the role**


As a Cloud Engineer III, you will be part of the consulting and delivery practice, utilizing cutting\-edge automation tools and provisioning in public cloud providers—preferably Azure or AWS. You will be responsible for designing and deploying well\-architected cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles and a proven track record of delivering cloud solutions with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation on various projects. Along the way, you will:

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure resources across AWS and Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and databases.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to automate application and infrastructure deployments.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
* Configure monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Experience with core cloud infrastructure services including:

* Experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, or Azure Repos.
* Experience with Linux/Unix and Windows environments, including system troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes (AKS or EKS).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch.
* Exposure to cloud migration tools (Azure Migrate or similar) and understanding of BCDR concepts.
* Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud\-based production environments.
* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or similar are a plus.
 **Professional Attributes**

* Demonstrates high integrity with a proactive and positive approach to work.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and team\-oriented environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a focus on delivering practical solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

3ef07a22.title: Solution Architect
3ef07a22.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The solution architect role involves designing and overseeing the implementation of home\-grown and commercial\-off\-the\-shelf IT solutions using Microsoft Azure and their integration with various systems and applications. The role involves collaborating with stakeholders, evaluating technology options, and guiding development teams to deliver scalable, secure and efficient solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Architectural Leadership:
   

  

* Serve as the Azure Solution Architect with specific sector knowledge, setting the direction for cloud architecture and ensuring alignment with the organization's technical strategy and O\&G industry standards.
* Uphold industry best practices and standards specific to the O\&G sector.


**Technology Roadmap**
* Construct and continuously update an Azure\-focused technology roadmap, aligning with the organization's long\-term goals.
* Explore and identify cutting\-edge Azure services and features that can propel technological advancement. Strategically plan and implement upgrades to bolster the organization's competitive position and enhance the scalability of Azure\-based solutions.


**Solution Design**
* Take the lead in design and architecture complex Azure solutions, with a strong focus on ensuring scalability, robust security, and cost\-effectiveness and alignment with nuanced demands of the O\&G industry.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Work in tandem with various service lines, such as engineering divisions and business stakeholders, to align Azure architectural strategies with the core business objectives and ensure the designs are in sync with the business's forward direction. Possess the ability to effectively communicate Azure technical strategies to non\-technical stakeholders, thereby facilitating their participation in informed decision\-making.


**Mentorship And Guidance**
* Offer Azure technical leadership and mentorship to solution squads.
* Cultivate an environment of innovation, continuous improvement, and technical prowess across the organization.


**Compliance And Best Practices**
* Guarantee Azure solutions meet regulatory demands and O\&G\-specific standards, including those related to safety, environment, and operations.


**Risk Assessment**
* Proactively identify and assess technical risks linked with Azure infrastructure and applications. Collaborate with multifaceted teams to formulate and implement measures to alleviate the detected risks. As a Solution Architect, it is crucial to pinpoint potential risks during the solution development phase and devise comprehensive risk mitigation plans for all solutions crafted.


**Industry Expertise**
* Stay informed about emerging technologies, trends, and standards in the oil and gas industry. Evaluate the potential impact of new technologies and provide recommendations for adoption both in upcoming solution designs as well as enhancement of solution architectures.


**Vendor Management**
* Engage with external vendors and technology associates to scrutinize third\-party offerings compatible with Azure. Integrate these third\-party solutions effortlessly, ensuring they complement and reinforce the broader Azure architectural strategy and the business objectives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s (or) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Technology or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Over all 10 \-15 \+ years of experience required for Solution Architect
* 8\+ years of prior experience as a solution architect, preferably in the oil and gas industry or 8\+ years of prior experience as a software engineer or similar role. Extensive experience in the oil and gas sector, including knowledge of industry\-specific challenges and opportunities.
* Technical Expertise: Strong experience should have an in\-depth understanding of Azure services and architecture, including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS solutions. They should be adept at designing and implementing complex cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. Also, strong experience in multi\-cloud environments like AWS, GCP and their application migrations and management in O\&G specifically.
* Advanced Problem\-Solving: They must possess strong analytical skills to troubleshoot and resolve high\-level technical issues. This includes the ability to perform root cause analysis and implement long\-term solutions to prevent recurrence.
* Strategic Planning: The architect should be capable of developing strategic plans for cloud adoption and migration, aligning with the organization's goals. They should be able to evaluate and recommend new technologies and approaches to drive continuous improvement.
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills are essential for translating technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, facilitating clear and effective discussions between cross\-functional teams, and presenting proposals and progress reports to senior management.
* Client Engagement: Capable to work closely with clients (internal clients) to understand their business requirements and constraints, ensuring that the cloud solutions designed meet their needs and expectations.
* Innovation: With extensive experience, they should be at the forefront of innovation, exploring new cloud technologies and methodologies, and integrating them into the organization's practices to gain competitive advantage.
* Leadership and Mentorship: As a seasoned leader, the Senior Solution Architect should set the technical direction and make pivotal decisions that define the organization's cloud strategy, while also serving as a mentor to uplift junior architects and engineers. They must lead by example, inspiring teams through complex initiatives and fostering professional growth by imparting knowledge, best practices, and constructive feedback to nurture the next generation of technical experts.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Must have Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering or information technology or Relevant field.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or similar.
* Microsoft AZ900 Certification \& AZ 305 Certification
* TOGAF or ArchiMate or Zachman or equivalent architecture frameworks experience
* Experience in automation using Python, Gen AI, AI Ops, etc.
* Experience with data integration, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., any 2 of following: Docker, OpenShift, Kubernetes, ECS, GKE, AKS, EKS, Rancher, Apache Mesos, Nomad, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes).
* Understanding of the O\&G sector's operational workflows, including the intricacies of exploration, extraction, refining, and distribution activities, to tailor cloud\-based solutions that complement the industry's unique needs.
* Competence in tackling technical hurdles specific to the O\&G domain, such as efficient asset management in isolated areas, processing extensive seismic datasets, and ensuring compliance with strict regulatory frameworks.
* Proficiency in leveraging Azure cloud technologies to enhance the O\&G Industry's operational effectiveness, utilizing tools like IoT, advanced data analytics, and machine learning for better results
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks (e.g. CircleCI, Jenkins, TeamCity, Travis CI, Bamboo, Bitbucket, etc.)
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


**How To Apply**
 To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time\-limited Visa status for this position.
   

  

**Privacy and Terms and Conditions**
 We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.
   

  

 Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.
   

  

**Terms of Use**
 “ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.
   

  

 This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.
   

  

 Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1\.30pm to 10\.30pm.
   

  

 Chevron participates in E\-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

53ff6a15.title: Solutions Architect
53ff6a15.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.

 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Pay Transparency:**
**Pay**
**Additional Details:**
 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

e2c6ba02.title: Service Delivery Manager
e2c6ba02.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description \-**
* Partnering with platform infrastructure leadership, all functions within, and I\&O leadership on financial analysis and tracking efficiency initiatives across the group. Coordinate with the business office concerning budget and efficiency savings.
* Collaborate with I\&O Product leads on executing strategic initiatives aimed at cost reduction and increased efficiencies aligned with strategic business goals.
* Responsible for the transition and transformation of vendor managed services.
* Drive governance across all towers including Hosting, Backup, Storage, Monitoring, Automation, and Batch Services, and support annual regulatory audits across all functions in I\&O.

* Manage contract deliverables, including reporting, service reviews, KPI dashboards, compliance checks, and transformation milestones. Manage monthly invoices and escalations.
* Coordinate audits and compliance reporting in partnership with EY Security, Risk, and Infosec teams. Act as a liaison between I\&O, Info Sec and Managed service provider to ensure governance is executed efficiently.
* Execute special strategic requests across platform infrastructure in partnership with tower, BAU team, and Kyndryl delivery team.
* Conduct operational governance reviews—weekly, monthly, and quarterly—with vendor and internal EY stakeholders.
* Track and resolve contractual non\-compliance, manage disputes, and collaborate with legal or procurement departments when necessary.
* Uses Agile and DevOps approaches to improve flow, increase delivery speed, and strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Manages budgets, costs, and service related risks to support informed decisions and predictable service outcomes.
* Analyse third\-party as well as internal processes, and create strategies for service delivery optimization
* Knowledge about AI, automation, Power BI/Power App dashboard development and Copilot Integration


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c6ea1229.title: Digital Marketing Delivery Manager
c6ea1229.description:
**About the Company**

**Godwin Digital Solutions** \[ https://godwindigitalsolutions.com ] is a fast\-growing 360° Digital Marketing Agency based in Kolkata, providing comprehensive digital marketing solutions to businesses across multiple industries. We specialize in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Performance Marketing, Social Media Management, Website Development, Google Business Profile Optimization, Branding, and Online Reputation Management.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a dynamic, proactive, and result\-oriented **Digital Marketing Manager** who can lead our execution team, coordinate with clients, and ensure the successful delivery of multiple digital marketing projects.

**Job Summary**

The Digital Marketing Manager will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end digital marketing operations across multiple client accounts.

The role requires strong leadership skills, sound knowledge of SEO and Social Media Marketing, the ability to manage internal teams, and confidence in interacting directly with clients.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience working in a digital marketing agency and should be capable of independently handling project execution, client communication, reporting, and basic performance marketing campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Management**

* Lead and supervise the SEO Executive, Social Media Executive, and Graphic Design Team.
* Allocate daily and weekly tasks while ensuring timely completion of deliverables.
* Monitor the quality and accuracy of work before it is delivered to clients.
* Conduct regular team meetings to review progress and resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure smooth coordination between content, design, SEO, and paid advertising teams.

**Client Account Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client objectives and translate them into actionable marketing strategies.
* Build long\-term professional relationships with clients through proactive communication.
* Attend client meetings both online and in person whenever required.

**Client Onboarding \& Platform Access**

* Coordinate with clients to obtain access to:
* Meta Business Manager
* Facebook \& Instagram Pages
* Google Ads
* Google Analytics
* Google Search Console
* Google Business Profile
* Website CMS
* Other digital assets required for campaign execution
* Guide clients remotely through screen sharing or video calls to grant required permissions.
* **Visit client offices when remote access or onboarding is not feasible.**

**SEO Management**

* Plan and supervise On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical SEO, and Local SEO activities.
* Review keyword research and content strategy.
* Monitor keyword rankings, website performance, and technical issues.
* Coordinate with content writers and designers for SEO implementation.
* Ensure timely execution of monthly SEO deliverables.

**Social Media Management**

* Oversee the creation of monthly social media content calendars.
* Review creative briefs before assigning work to the graphic design team.
* Ensure timely publishing of posts across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Maintain quality, consistency, and brand alignment across all client accounts.

**Reporting \& Performance Analysis**

* Prepare and review monthly SEO reports.
* Prepare and review monthly Social Media performance reports.
* Present campaign performance and insights to clients.
* Track KPIs and recommend strategies for continuous improvement.
* Ensure all reports are accurate, data\-driven, and submitted within agreed timelines.

**Performance Marketing**

The candidate should possess working knowledge of:

* Meta Ads Manager
* Google Ads
* Campaign creation
* Audience targeting
* Budget allocation
* Performance monitoring
* Basic campaign optimization

While advanced expertise is not mandatory, the candidate should be capable of independently managing primary\-level advertising campaigns and coordinating with senior specialists when required.

**Process Improvement**

* Develop and improve internal workflows.
* Maintain project trackers and ensure adherence to deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve team productivity and campaign efficiency.
* Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, Google algorithm updates, Meta platform changes, and AI\-powered marketing tools.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of SEO (On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical \& Local SEO)
* Knowledge of Google Search Console and Google Analytics
* Experience managing Google Business Profile
* Good understanding of Meta Business Suite and Meta Business Manager
* Knowledge of Facebook \& Instagram marketing
* Basic knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads
* Ability to interpret campaign analytics and performance data
* Strong project management and multitasking skills
* Excellent client handling and communication skills
* Strong leadership and team management abilities
* Ability to work under deadlines in a fast\-paced agency environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Digital Marketing certifications \- will be an added advantage.

**Experience Required**

* 2–3 years of experience in Digital Marketing.
* Minimum 1 years of experience working in a Digital Marketing Agency.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a team is preferred.

**Personal Attributes**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Client\-focused and solution\-driven
* Capable of taking ownership of projects from initiation to completion
* Comfortable working in a startup environment with evolving responsibilities
* Adaptable, resourceful, and eager to learn new technologies and marketing trends

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with clients across diverse industries.
* A collaborative and growth\-oriented startup environment.
* Leadership opportunities with high ownership and responsibility.
* Exposure to SEO, Social Media Marketing, Performance Marketing, Branding, and Web Projects.
* Career growth based on performance and contribution.

**Why Join Us?**

If you're passionate about digital marketing, enjoy managing teams, thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment, and want to grow with an ambitious startup, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and play a key role in shaping impactful digital marketing campaigns while building long\-term success for our clients.

\*\* KINDLY READ TILL THE END BEFORE APPLYING FOR THIS JOB.

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal

 As a Delivery Manager in Google Cloud’s Professional Services organization, you will lead a team of technical consultants and Cloud engineers providing consulting services to enterprise organizations adopting Google Workspace and associated solutions.  Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. f588892b.description:
Spaulding Ridge is an advisory and IT implementation firm. We help global organizations get financial clarity into the complex, daily sales, and operational decisions that impact profitable revenue generations, efficient operational performance, and reliable financial management.
   

  

 At Spaulding Ridge, we believe all business is personal. Core to our values is our relationships with our clients, our business partners, our team, and the global community. Our employees dedicate their time to helping our clients transform their business, from strategy through implementation and business transformation.
   

  

**What You Will Do And Learn**
 As the IT Operations \& Service Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for leading and managing Service Desk operations, End User Services, Asset Management, Infrastructure Operations coordination, vendor relationships, and enterprise service delivery. You will play a critical role in ensuring a consistent, scalable, and high\-quality technology experience for employees globally.
   

  

 This role requires a strong operational leader who can manage day\-to\-day support activities while driving process improvement, automation, service excellence, and vendor accountability. The position will also serve as the operational owner of Jira Service Management and support key initiatives related to employee lifecycle management, asset lifecycle management, and IT service modernization.
   

  

 The role supports a global workforce and requires regular overlap with US Central Time business hours, with availability until at least 1:00 PM CT.
   

  

**Ideal candidates will be able to:**
 Service Desk \& End User Services Management:
   

  

* Oversee the operations of the IT Service Desk, ensuring efficient and effective support services are provided to end users globally.

* Implement and enforce service management best practices to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Monitor Service Desk performance metrics, KPIs, SLAs, ticket trends, and service quality.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, productivity, and user experience.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex operational issues and service interruptions.


 IT Operations \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide leadership and oversight for day\-to\-day IT Operations activities.
* Coordinate support activities across Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, and Enterprise Applications teams.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to support analysts and operational staff.
* Assist with escalation management and complex troubleshooting activities when required.
* Support implementation and adoption of new technologies, tools, and operational processes.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Infrastructure teams to ensure operational readiness and service continuity.


 Infrastructure, Cloud Operations \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Coordinate operational support activities related to cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and enterprise platforms.
* Manage relationships with managed service providers (MSPs), technology vendors, and support partners.
* Conduct operational reviews with vendors and monitor SLA performance.
* Ensure vendors meet contractual obligations and service expectations.
* Coordinate escalations and service improvement initiatives with external partners.
* Support operational governance of cloud services and enterprise technology platforms.


 Asset Lifecycle Management
   

  

* Own the lifecycle management of employee technology assets.
* Maintain governance over inventory, procurement coordination, deployment, recovery, and disposal processes.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding hardware logistics globally.
* Ensure accurate asset tracking, reporting, and lifecycle management.
* Drive improvements to hardware provisioning, recovery, and inventory management processes.


 Employee Lifecycle \& IT Operations Support
   

  

* Provide end to end operational support for employee onboarding, offboarding, and employee transitions.
* Coordinate user account management, access requests, hardware provisioning, and technology readiness.
* Partner with HR, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure smooth employee lifecycle processes.
* Maintain documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Support automation initiatives related to employee lifecycle management and access management processes.


 Jira \& IT Service Management Ownership
   

  

* Serve as the operational owner for Jira and Jira Service Management platforms.
* Maintain governance standards, workflows, permissions, reporting, and service management processes.
* Partner with business stakeholders to support platform adoption and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate Jira enhancements and support activities with implementation partners and vendors.
* Ensure Jira and ITSM platforms support organizational standards and operational objectives.


 Security \& Compliance Support
   

  

* Support IT operational compliance and security initiatives.
* Coordinate with Security teams during investigations, incidents, and remediation activities.
* Ensure operational processes align with company security policies and standards.
* Fulfill responsibilities defined by the organization's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Assist with audits, access reviews, and compliance reporting as required.


 Performance Management \& Reporting
   

  

* Create, maintain, monitor, and report on Service Desk and IT Operations KPIs and SLAs.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and operational reviews.
* Analyze trends and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and service improvement.
* Present operational performance, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
* Act as an ambassador for IT initiatives and build strong cross\-functional relationships across the organization.


**Qualifications:**
* BA/BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Business Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, Service Desk Management, Infrastructure Operations, or End User Services.
* Experience managing MSPs, vendors, and external technology partners.
* Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, and endpoint management.
* Experience with Jira and Jira Service Management administration and governance.
* Strong understanding of IT service management principles and operational best practices.
* Experience supporting cloud\-based environments and enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced international environment.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, flexible, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to influence, drive change, and champion new initiatives across the organization.
* In\-depth practical knowledge of troubleshooting and administration of commonly used applications.
* Experience with employee lifecycle automation and identity management processes.
* Experience driving automation and operational transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting globally distributed workforces.
* Ability to work overlapping hours with US Central Time teams, including availability through approximately 1:00 PM CT as part of regular working hours.


 Strong verbal and written English communication skills required. Ability to work directly with US\-based business and technology stakeholder
   

  

**Spaulding Ridge’s Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace**

We do this by creating a culture of trust and belonging, through practices and policies that support inclusion, and through our employee led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs): CRE (Cultural Race and Ethnicity), Women Elevate, PROUD and Mental Wellness Alliance.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Spaulding Ridge and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to our VP of Human Resources, Cara Halladay (challaday@spauldingridge.com). * Track and report on AI initiative performance metrics including adoption, productivity impact, and value realization in support of enterprise savings targets

* Define project scope, success criteria, timelines, and resource requirements in collaboration with IT leadership
* Coordinate with platform owners, vendors, and internal teams to ensure delivery alignment across all active workstreams
* Maintain a consolidated view of portfolio health, surfacing dependencies and conflicts proactively



**Governance and Reporting** 



* Produce executive\-ready project status updates, steering committee materials, and program dashboards
* Ensure projects adhere to established intake, scoring, and lifecycle governance processes, applying AI Readiness Program standards to applicable Enterprise AI workstreams
* Maintain documentation standards across all managed initiatives, including project charters, decision logs, and closure reports
* Deliver structured stakeholder communications on a recurring cadence: weekly status updates for active workstreams, monthly program summaries for IT leadership, and quarterly reviews for executive and cross\-functional stakeholders



**Stakeholder and Change Management** 



* Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across IT, business functions, and external vendors

* Act as a trusted point of contact for project stakeholders, proactively managing expectations and ensuring alignment at every phase


 Qualifications:

* 6 to 9 years of experience in technical project management within an enterprise IT environment
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross\-functional programs with multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong command of Agile and sprint\-based delivery methodologies, with hands\-on experience running sprint ceremonies and managing iterative delivery cycles alongside Waterfall or hybrid approaches
* Proficiency with project and work management platforms such as ServiceNow, Wrike, Jira, or equivalent
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience producing materials for senior and executive audiences
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity, navigate organizational complexity, and maintain delivery momentum without direct authority
* Ability to work in a hybrid, globally distributed team environment with availability to maintain core working hour overlap through at least 12:00 PM EST to support cross\-regional collaboration



**Preferred** 



* PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent project management certification
* Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, particularly ServiceNow
* Exposure to AI program governance, adoption tracking, or enterprise AI rollouts
* Experience supporting change management or internal communications workstreams as part of broader program delivery
* Prior experience in a SaaS, technology, or high\-growth enterprise environment
