 * Full ownership of the Enterprise AI Initiatives project portfolio, with status reporting cadence established, governance applied, and key stakeholders aligned
* Clear portfolio view of all active IT initiatives across functions, with risks and dependencies documented
* Relationships established with key cross\-functional partners across IT, Communications, Finance, and People
* Governance and documentation standards applied consistently across managed workstreams

The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. 35f4fa72.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
35f4fa72.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 NetApp Keystone is a pay\-as\-you\-grow, subscription\-based service that delivers a seamless hybrid cloud experience for customers who prefer an OpEx consumption model over a CapEx or leasing model. By removing the IT burdens of managing storage infrastructures, customers can better align storage costs to business needs, accelerate time to value, and focus on core business operations by managing outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager in the Keystone PMO, you will play a pivotal role in driving complex, cross\-functional initiatives that deliver new features to the market for NetApp's STaaS offering. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, GTM and business operations teams to define program goals, manage timelines, and mitigate risks. Leveraging your exceptional leadership, communication and technical skills, you’ll ensure that projects are executed efficiently and align with strategic objectives.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

* Overseeing multiple concurrent programs, developing detailed project plans, and communicating progress and challenges to stakeholders at all levels.
* Enable cooperation and alignment in the program across all roles and functions in multiple geos.
* Relentless follow up across multiple teams, navigate through ambiguity and drive towards common goals.
* Build deep and productive working relationships across Engineering, product management and business operations, understanding the Keystone product, challenging business assumptions and offering a point of view to assist in the decision\-making process.
* Identify important issues and risks, recommend options and facilitate team decisions.
* Anticipate roadblocks, resolve conflicts, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
* Lead regular program reviews with VPs and senior leaders.
* Drive product launch announcements and Enablement collateral with GTM, Marketing and Product teams
* Effective use of available AI technologies(Cursor, Copilot) to bring process efficiencies.


**Key Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment
* Results oriented: proven track record to take initiative, work with minimal direction, to deliver results.
* Expertise in JIRA, ADO, Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, SharePoint etc.
* 8\+ years of experience in engineering/ technical project management / release management, with a proven track record of delivering complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Good understanding of release management methodologies and best practices.
* Ability to understand project and resource interdependencies within a program or portfolio.
* Ability to influence at all levels in a highly matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated ability to mitigate risks proactively, resolve issues, and escalate when appropriate.
* Storage industry experience \& PMP Certification is a plus


 Education
   

  

* A minimum of 8 years of experience is required.
* A Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or a Master’s Degree; or equivalent experience is required.


 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

d4e4aad4.title: Technical Program Manager III, IES Prime
d4e4aad4.description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about building innovative technology solutions that drive Prime membership growth and deliver personalized experiences? Join our IES Prime team where you'll lead complex technical programs across multiple stakeholders to create differentiated customer journeys throughout the Prime lifecycle. In this role, you'll leverage your deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems to drive strategic initiatives that connect various Amazon systems, enhancing the end\-to\-end Prime experience for customers in Emerging Markets.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of customer experience and technical implementation, you'll tackle challenges across distributed systems, customer\-facing applications, high\-throughput production environments, and the application of ML/AI to enhance the Prime membership journey. This unique position offers exceptional visibility across Amazon's ecosystem while contributing to Prime's north star vision of becoming Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and validate complex program requirements across multiple stakeholder teams, solving ambiguous problems and proactively identifying risks related to Prime lifecycle experiences
* Partner with engineering teams to create high\-level technical designs and architectural for implementing solutions that integrate with various Amazon systems, ensuring scalability and performance for high\-volume customer experiences
* Drive end\-to\-end program management for technical initiatives that enhance Prime membership growth, benefit engagement
* Lead technical discussions with cross\-functional teams to align business needs with technical constraints, making smart trade\-offs between short and long\-term requirements
* Streamline processes and implement operational excellence procedures to improve concurrent project delivery while monitoring metrics and program health


 A day in the life
   

  

 As an example \- Your day begins with leading a cross\-team planning session to align stakeholders on integration challenges for an upcoming Prime benefit enhancement. You'll brainstorm solutions for scaling a personalized post\-signup journey, then unblock your team by facilitating a design review with partner engineering teams. Afterward, you'll contribute to the team's architectural evolution during a technical review session, analyze program metrics, and prepare updates for leadership on the progress of your initiatives that improve Prime's value\-for\-money promise in price\-sensitive markets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Prime's north star vision is to be Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program, delivering profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience. Our tech team drives Prime business growth in Emerging Markets through innovative technology solutions. The IES Prime team drives the growth of Prime membership by delivering personalized, contextual, and value\-led experiences across the member lifecycle. Our mandate spans creating differentiated post\-sign\-up journeys, deepening benefit engagement, communicating value realized through personalized experiences, and enabling seamless renewals that reinforce Prime's value\-for\-money promise—a core differentiator in price\-sensitive markets.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder‑management skills.

c481c202.title: Technical Program Manager
c481c202.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future\-proof their businesses. Through real\-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud\-first, AI\-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager in Cloud Operations, you will drive operational reliability across our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem. You will lead critical incident post\-mortems, govern security frameworks, and partner with application development and platform engineering teams to ensure all new services meet strict production entry criteria for reliability and observability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

**Production Readiness \& Operations Governance**
* Define, govern, and enforce production entry criteria for all new services and features.
* Partner with application development and platform engineering to audit deployment readiness.
* Validate that incoming services meet corporate standards for observability, monitoring, and alerting.
* Scale reliable operational practices across engineering teams to reduce launch\-day risks.


**Critical Incident \& Post\-Mortem Management**
* Own the end\-to\-end post\-mortem lifecycle for critical GCP production outages and high\-severity incidents.
* Lead "Five Whys" and blameless Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions to identify system vulnerabilities.
* Track actionable remediation items, ensuring timely execution to prevent recurrence.
* Report SLA/SLO compliance metrics and incident trends to engineering leadership.


**Release Management \& Compliance Coordination**
* Bridge the gap between engineering, QA, and cloud operations to ensure streamlined CI/CD pipelines.
* Align release schedules with maintenance windows to minimize customer impact and system downtime.
* Partner with InfoSec to enforce Google Cloud security, data governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain documentation and evidence collection for ongoing infrastructure compliance audits.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience: 5\+ years of Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience.
* GCP Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud services, security controls, and infrastructure.
* Production Readiness: Proven experience defining and enforcing production entry, reliability, and observability criteria.
* Incident Management: Strong track record running blameless post\-mortems and driving infrastructure solutions from RCAs.
* Release \& DevSecOps: Deep understanding of modern CI/CD tools, release management, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Communication: Ability to align cross\-functional engineering teams around shared operational and reliability goals.


**Location:**
* India – (Flexible hybrid work model \- work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter)

6792e2eb.description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a member of our core Solution Consulting team, you will play a critical role in driving our future success by being the champion of recommending AI\-first business transformation to some of the most important customers in India and help them create a vision to execute plan.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, Partners, and the executive team to shape customer strategy, position differentiated solutions, and demonstrate measurable business value.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on presales role for an experienced Solution Consultant who can combine technical depth, industry understanding, and executive\-level communication. The successful candidate will be able to translate complex business challenges into compelling solution narratives, articulate the value of AI to CXO audiences, and connect ServiceNow capabilities to the industry processes that matter most to customers.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
 The Solution Consultant is a senior technical and business advisor with the ability to develop, position, and demonstrate differentiated solutions throughout the sales cycle while contributing to quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.
   

  

* Act as the technical, solution, and industry expert within a client\-facing sales team.
* Partner with Sales to shape account strategy, qualify opportunities, and develop compelling solution approaches.
* Lead discovery and solution workshops to understand customer priorities, industry processes, operational challenges, and desired business outcomes.
* Build and deliver differentiated solution demonstrations that clearly connect ServiceNow capabilities to customer needs and measurable value.
* Develop and communicate a compelling AI narrative for CXO audiences, explaining how AI can improve productivity, decision\-making, customer and employee experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance.
* Translate AI capabilities into practical industry use cases, clearly articulating the business value, adoption considerations, governance requirements, and expected outcomes.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of relevant industry processes and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and transform work across the enterprise.
* Engage confidently with business and technology executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CHROs, COOs, CISOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Answer product, architecture, integration, security, AI, and technical questions from customers, partners, and ServiceNow colleagues.
* Provide feedback to Product Management on customer requirements, industry needs, competitive gaps, and potential product enhancements.
* Develop, share, and reuse best practices, industry narratives, demonstrations, and solution assets to improve the effectiveness of the wider Solution Consulting team.
* Stay current on AI developments, industry trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and ServiceNow’s market differentiation.
* Support executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, user groups, trade shows, and other strategic marketing activities.


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* A minimum of 7 years of direct presales Solution Consulting or Sales Engineering experience in enterprise software or cloud technology.
* Demonstrated experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and solution design through executive presentations, demonstrations, technical validation, and deal closure.
* The ability to develop and deliver compelling AI narratives to CXO audiences, clearly connecting AI capabilities to business priorities, operational outcomes, and measurable value.
* A practical understanding of how AI can be embedded into enterprise workflows, decision\-making, automation, and business processes.
* The ability to explain AI concepts in clear business language, including value, adoption, trust, governance, risk, and organisational impact.
* Strong knowledge of relevant industry processes, operating models, business challenges, and transformation priorities.
* The ability to connect technology capabilities to industry\-specific use cases and quantify the potential business impact.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* The ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders and adapt the narrative for different audiences.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise in enterprise cloud software, workflow platforms, SaaS solutions, integrations, data, and AI.
* Experience collaborating with Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Partners, Customer Success, and Professional Services.
* Strong territory and opportunity management skills, including pipeline development, deal qualification, account planning, and close partnership with Sales.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in complex, fast\-moving enterprise sales environments.
* Willingness to travel as required.


 FD21

**The Solution Architect supports process transformation and product development by bridging the specific business problems (and issues) to the technologies that support them.  Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
   

  

 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
   

  

 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
   

  

 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glean is looking for a talented Solutions Engineering Manager (SEM) to join our dynamic APAC team. As an SEM, you will be responsible for leading a team of solutions engineers (SEs) to ensure both prospects and Glean customers receive top\-notch technical guidance and value. The Bangalore Solution Engineering Manager will be responsible for driving and improving pre\-sales engagements, such as, technical discovery, custom product demonstrations, use case workshops, and pilots. Additionally, the SEM will be responsible for driving and improving customer adoption, growth, and business value of Glean’s transformational Work AI platform.
   

  

**You Will**
* Develop and lead a high\-performing team of solutions engineers, providing mentorship, guidance, coaching, and ongoing support.
* Establish and maintain your role as a territory / segment’s primary technical advisor; think of yourself as the CTO of every customer relationship.
* Work with your team of SEs as well as prospects and customers to connect to new data sources including custom integrations.
* Leverage top sales methodologies and frameworks, like Command of the Message and MEDDPICC, to lead technical discovery and improve scoping, deal inspection, and technical and business value delivery.
* Identify opportunities for expansion of Glean within customer install bases.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally (including, sales and services) to ensure priorities and expectations between Glean and the customer are aligned and executed.
* Help troubleshoot, prioritize, and escalate issues for assigned customers, ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Support to drive customer satisfaction, and be the voice of the field to prioritize product enhancements.
* Be an active member of the Glean customer technical community helping to drive industry recognition and best practices.


**About You** 
  

  

* Pre or post\-sales solution consultant experience in a rapidly growing software company.
* Proven experience in people leadership, talent development, and performance management.
* 7\-10 plus years of SE experience: Managers typically have a proven track record of success in sales engineering, with experience working on complex deals and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* API and integration experience in a hybrid or SaaS environment.
* Deep understanding of cloud architecture, security, and networking, including cloud and on\-premise.
* Deep understanding of integration architecture, including API expertise
* Hands\-on experience with cloud technologies, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure.
* Cloud security, information security, and audit experience to represent technical and audit frameworks with customer stakeholders and executives.
* Strong Technical Background: SEM must have a strong understanding of the company's products and services, as well as the technical skills to provide guidance and coaching to SEs and customers.
* Project Management Skills: Managers must be able to balance multiple priorities and projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and allocate resources effectively.
* Presentation and Communication skills: SEMs must be able to communicate technical information to non\-technical stakeholders, both internally and externally.
* Interpersonal Skills:
+ Excellent active listening, communication, and professional presentation skills.
+ High emotional intelligence.
+ Project planning and execution capabilities.
+ Proactive and self\-motivated.
+ Highly organized and detail\-oriented.
+ Startup DNA \+ Do Whatever It Takes (DWIT)
+ Data\-driven mindset for assessing success and identifying opportunities for improvement.


**Location:**

**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 We are a diverse bunch of people, and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
   

  

**AI\-First Mindset At Glean**

The Senior Solutions Architect provides technical leadership and designs complex solution architectures that support business strategy and streamline technology\-enabled workflows. This role partners closely with business owners, product, data, and engineering teams to document current\-state systems and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud\-based solutions. This position focuses on emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and machine learning, and guides solutions from research and analysis through architecture, delivery support, and operational readiness.


**What you will do:**


* Lead discovery with business and technology partners to understand objectives, constraints, current\-state systems, and integration points.
* Document current\-state architecture and define target\-state designs including system context diagrams, component designs, integration patterns, and data flows.
* Design and modernize applications into cloud\-compatible or cloud\-native architectures using microservices, serverless, and event\-driven patterns where appropriate.
* Create strategies, roadmaps, and migration designs for transitioning applications and data workloads to cloud platforms.
* Design AI and ML\-enabled solutions, including model integration into products and business processes, and patterns for scalable inference and low\-latency serving where needed.
* Design Generative AI solution patterns, such as retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and API integration, prompt and context management, and evaluation approaches.
* Define reference architectures for AI platforms and enabling capabilities, such as data pipelines, feature and embedding generation, vector storage, model endpoints, and integration with enterprise APIs.
* Define integration patterns for agent toolchains using standards and common approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), skills and plugin manifest standards, function calling with JSON Schema tool definitions, OpenAPI\-based tool specifications, and event\-driven or message\-based tool execution patterns. Ensure integrations address authentication and authorization, data minimization, auditability, and isolation boundaries.
* Incorporate security\-by\-design practices into architectures, including identity and access controls, encryption, secrets management, secure networking, and audit logging.
* Partner with governance and risk stakeholders to ensure responsible AI considerations are incorporated, including privacy, explainability, safety, compliance, and model risk controls as applicable.
* Drive alignment and adoption of proposed solutions by clearly communicating tradeoffs, risks, and value and obtaining stakeholder alignment and governance approvals. Selling means internal alignment and decision support, not external pre\-sales.
* Support teams responsible for testing and validation and help triage and resolve design\-related issues found during development, UAT, or production.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**What you will bring:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in agile software delivery environments with increasing architecture and design responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems using microservices and or serverless patterns.
* Experience designing and integrating AI and ML capabilities into applications, including model serving considerations and data dependencies.
* Experience with one or more languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Scala.
* Experience with data persistence technologies across SQL and NoSQL.
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and core cloud design patterns.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated testing and deployment automation.
* Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into clear technical direction.

**What will set you apart:**


* Hands\-on experience with GenAI and LLM solutions, including retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, evaluation, and production monitoring.
* Experience with AI and ML platforms or services, such as AWS SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with MCP\-based integrations and related agent tool standards, including skills and plugin manifests, function calling schemas, and OpenAPI\-defined tools, plus secure enterprise integration patterns.
* Container and orchestration experience, such as Docker and Kubernetes, and cloud container platforms like ECS or EKS.
* Experience with vector databases and search technologies and associated indexing and retrieval patterns.
* Experience with enterprise observability, including centralized logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and operational readiness.
* Database and procedural development experience, including PL/SQL, and strong data modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices, governance controls, and security considerations specific to AI systems.

**Practice Director – Business Applications (Tax Automation \& ERP Solutions)**
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (On\-site)
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
**Reports To:** Executive Leadership
**About Evoort Solutions**
Evoort Solutions is a rapidly growing technology consulting, product engineering, and enterprise integration company serving customers across North America and global markets. Our expertise spans Enterprise Applications, AI Solutions, API Development, Cloud Technologies, Digital Commerce, Custom Software Development, and System Integration.
Over the past several years, Evoort Solutions has established strong capabilities in enterprise integration and tax automation through successful delivery of Avalara integrations across multiple eCommerce platforms. Our team has successfully delivered more than 20 Avalara integration projects supporting Sales Tax and Excise Tax automation for customers operating on Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, Microsoft Dynamics, and other enterprise platforms.
As part of our next phase of growth, Evoort Solutions is building a dedicated Business Applications Practice focused on:
* Avalara Tax Automation \& Compliance Implementation Services
* Avalara Connector \& Integration Development
* Odoo ERP Consulting \& Implementation Services
* AI\-enabled Business Process Automation
* API\-driven Enterprise Integration Solutions

We are seeking an entrepreneurial Practice Director who will establish, lead, and scale this strategic business unit.
**Position Summary**
The Practice Director will be responsible for building and growing Evoort Solutions' Business Applications Practice with an initial focus on Tax Automation and ERP Consulting.
This is a leadership position requiring a unique combination of business consulting, ERP implementation expertise, enterprise application knowledge, solution architecture understanding, pre\-sales consulting, delivery governance, and practice development.
The successful candidate will work directly with executive leadership to define the long\-term strategy while independently building the consulting practice, recruiting and mentoring team members, creating implementation methodologies, supporting sales opportunities, and delivering successful customer implementations.
While prior experience with Avalara or Odoo is highly desirable, the most important qualification is proven success leading ERP consulting practices, enterprise software implementations, business transformation initiatives, and customer\-facing solution delivery. Evoort Solutions will support the selected candidate in obtaining advanced Avalara and Odoo product knowledge, certifications, and partner enablement.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Practice Leadership \& Strategy**
* Build and lead Evoort Solutions' Business Applications Practice.
* Define the long\-term vision, service portfolio, implementation methodologies, and growth strategy.
* Establish scalable consulting, implementation, managed services, and product offerings.
* Develop reusable implementation accelerators, templates, frameworks, and best practices.
* Define KPIs, utilization targets, delivery standards, and customer success metrics.
* Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic growth initiatives and technology investments.

**Business Development \& Pre\-Sales**
* Lead customer discovery workshops and business process assessments.
* Translate business challenges into technology\-driven solutions.
* Conduct executive presentations, solution demonstrations, and strategic consulting sessions.
* Prepare solution proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), implementation estimates, and project plans.
* Support enterprise sales opportunities from qualification through solution design.
* Collaborate with technology partners on joint go\-to\-market initiatives.

**Tax Automation \& Compliance Practice**
Lead the development of consulting and implementation services for:
* Sales \& Use Tax Automation
* Excise Tax Automation
* Tax Compliance Processes
* Nexus Management
* Tax Determination
* Exemption Certificate Management
* Compliance Reporting
* eCommerce Tax Automation
* ERP Tax Automation
* Multi\-jurisdiction Tax Configuration

Work closely with Evoort leadership and technology partners to expand implementation capabilities and establish a recognized tax automation practice.
**ERP Consulting Practice**
Lead consulting and implementation services involving:
* Business Process Analysis
* Finance \& Accounting
* Order\-to\-Cash
* Procure\-to\-Pay
* Inventory \& Warehouse Management
* Manufacturing
* Supply Chain
* CRM
* Project Management
* Reporting \& Business Intelligence

Develop standardized implementation methodologies for rapid project delivery.
**Delivery Leadership**
* Oversee consulting engagements from initiation through post\-go\-live support.
* Establish delivery governance, quality standards, and project review processes.
* Mentor consultants, architects, developers, analysts, and implementation teams.
* Ensure successful customer outcomes and long\-term client relationships.

**Team Building \& Talent Development**
* Recruit, mentor, and develop high\-performing consultants, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and project managers.
* Build a scalable consulting organization capable of supporting global customers.
* Establish internal training programs and career development plans.
* Coordinate product certifications and partner enablement programs.

**Innovation \& Product Development**
Collaborate with Evoort's engineering and AI teams to build:
* Productized implementation offerings
* Avalara integration accelerators
* Odoo implementation frameworks
* Shopify public applications
* ERP integration connectors
* AI\-powered implementation assistants
* API\-based automation services
* Self\-service onboarding platforms

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in ERP consulting, enterprise applications, digital transformation, or business solutions.
* 5\+ years in consulting leadership, practice management, or solution delivery leadership.
* Proven experience leading ERP implementation programs and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Tax, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Inventory, and Order Management processes.
* Demonstrated success supporting pre\-sales activities including workshops, solution presentations, effort estimation, proposal development, and customer consulting.
* Experience building, mentoring, and managing consulting or implementation teams.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with international customers, preferably North America.
* Willingness to work from Evoort Solutions' Ahmedabad office.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)**
Experience with one or more of the following technologies or business domains is highly desirable:
**Tax Automation \& Compliance**
* Avalara
* Vertex
* Sovos
* Sales \& Use Tax
* Excise Tax
* VAT/GST
* Tax Compliance Solutions

**ERP Platforms**
* Odoo
* SAP
* Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Oracle ERP
* NetSuite
* Acumatica
* Sage
* Infor

**Digital Commerce**
* Shopify
* Adobe Commerce (Magento)
* BigCommerce
* WooCommerce

**Enterprise Integration**
* REST APIs
* Middleware
* Integration Platforms
* Cloud Applications
* Enterprise SaaS

**Direct experience with Avalara and/or Odoo is considered a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates with strong ERP consulting, business process transformation, and tax/compliance domain expertise who demonstrate the ability to quickly learn and lead Avalara and Odoo practices are encouraged to apply.**
**Leadership Competencies**
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
* Entrepreneurial mindset
* Strategic vision
* Practice\-building capability
* Customer\-centric consulting approach
* Business transformation expertise
* Technology leadership
* Team development and coaching
* Commercial awareness
* Innovation mindset
* Executive communication skills
* Ownership and accountability
* Continuous learning and adaptability

**Success Measures (First 24 Months)**
The successful candidate will be expected to:
* Build and operationalize Evoort Solutions' Business Applications Practice.
* Establish dedicated Avalara Tax Automation \& Compliance consulting services.
* Launch Odoo ERP implementation and support services.
* Recruit and mentor a high\-performing consulting and delivery team.
* Develop standardized implementation methodologies and reusable accelerators.
* Expand partner enablement and certifications for Avalara and Odoo.
* Support development of scalable SaaS products and enterprise connectors.
* Increase recurring implementation, managed services, and support revenue.
* Position Evoort Solutions as a trusted consulting and implementation partner for tax automation and ERP transformation initiatives.

**Why Join Evoort Solutions?**
This is an opportunity to build a practice—not simply manage one.
You will have executive sponsorship, an established customer base, strong engineering capabilities, successful Avalara integration experience, and the freedom to define the strategy, recruit your team, establish delivery methodologies, and create innovative solutions that shape the future of Evoort Solutions' Business Applications portfolio.
If you are passionate about building consulting organizations, leading digital transformation, and creating scalable technology practices, we invite you to join Evoort Solutions and play a defining role in our next phase of growth.

* Support management of critical customer cutovers, weekend activities and enterprise delivery requirements

* Strong customer service, project management and quality control skills
* Proven experience managing escalations and enterprise customer situations
* Strong resource planning and operational management skills
* Excellent leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Strong teamwork skills and attention to detail

**Description**
 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross\-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9\+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C\-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry\-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning \& Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.


**Cloud Specific Experience**
 Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
   

  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands\-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber \& data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.

Vista’s ecosystem enables purposeful career mobility and sustained professional growth. 28635034.title: Program Manager, NCC, Network Control Center
28635034.description:
**Description**
 Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.
   

  

 Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.
   

  

 We are seeking a Program Manager to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high\-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be at the center of that response — running incidents end\-to\-end, driving cross\-functional coordination under pressure, and ensuring leadership has the information they need to make decisions fast.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Manage high\-severity incidents (Sev1/Sev2\) impacting Amazon CS customers by running bridge calls and coordinating with Service Delivery, Product, Engineering, PR, Legal, and Security Operations teams to drive resolution
* Triage technical and operational incidents, assess customer impact, and coordinate with relevant teams to identify root cause and resolution path
* Initiate and manage proactive customer communications including website/app banners, IVR updates, and mass notifications to reduce anxiety contacts during known issues
* Protect contact channels by identifying known\-issue volume and ensuring customers with genuine issues can reach Customer Service without congestion
* Provide regular, timely updates to senior leadership with clear customer impact assessments, resolution timelines, and status indicators
* Dive deep into incident data, identify systemic problems, and present solutions and preventive measures to leadership
* Develop, maintain, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for incident response scenarios, including coordination playbooks for cross\-functional teams

1f9fa677.title: Staff Solutions Engineer (India)
1f9fa677.description:
Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
   

  

 We are a globally distributed, remote\-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Staff Solutions Engineer** 
 with strong technical credibility and the ability to operate across direct enterprise, partner, and developer community motions in one of Docker's highest\-priority APAC markets. India is Docker's third\-largest APAC market and home to the world's second\-largest developer community, combining a massive open\-source ecosystem, a large IT services sector, and a high\-growth enterprise segment.
   

  

 This role requires an SE who can engage Fortune\-equivalent enterprises directly, enable a diverse channel partner ecosystem, and build authentic presence in one of the world's most active developer communities. The scope extends beyond India, with periodic travel to Southeast Asia to support regional coverage.
   

  

 This role reports to the SE Leader, APAC.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Partner Enablement and Channel Development
   

  

* Enable and co\-sell with Docker's channel partner ecosystem to deliver technical coverage across India's diverse partner landscape, including large SIs, IT services companies, regional VARs, and hyperscaler partner teams.
* Run joint partner workshops, technical enablement sessions, and solution briefings to build partner SE capability.
* Support partner\-led opportunities with architectural depth, PoC support, and competitive differentiation.
* Develop and maintain partner\-ready technical assets: demo environments, reference architectures, and enablement decks.
* Build strong working relationships with key SI, IT services, and reseller contacts across India's channel ecosystem, where the same organisations often represent both partner and customer opportunities.
* Support pipeline development across both direct and partner\-sourced opportunities.


 Evangelist and Community Presence
   

  

* Build Docker's technical presence across India's developer and DevSecOps community, spanning major tech hubs including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, and Mumbai.
* Speak at industry and partner\-organised conferences, including India's growing DevSecOps, cloud\-native, and AI developer circuit.
* Produce technical content — blog posts, how\-to guides, and solution briefs — that addresses gaps in Docker documentation and resonates with the India developer community.
* Represent Docker at meetups, developer days, and hackathons to drive awareness and top\-of\-funnel interest.


 Strategic Customer Engagement
   

  

* Lead deep technical discovery across Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, and AI teams at strategic accounts to understand:
+ AI governance requirements and agentic development workflows
+ Software supply chain risk and secure build pipeline needs
+ Regulatory and compliance drivers relevant to the Indian market (DPDP Act, CERT\-In, RBI circulars for BFSI, SEBI for capital markets, MeitY requirements for public sector)
+ Container security posture and DevSecOps maturity

* Design, position, and execute structured PoCs/PoVs with clear success criteria and executive\-ready value summaries.
* Influence buying decisions through demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and technical executive briefings.
* Translate Docker's AI security and governance capabilities into business value narratives for CISOs, Heads of Platform Engineering, and AI leaders.
* Build and maintain relationships with technical champions across Security, DevOps, Platform, and AI teams at key accounts.
* Support renewal and expansion motions by maintaining engagement beyond the initial sale on key accounts.


 AI Solutions Advocacy
   

  

* Position and demonstrate Docker's AI portfolio as the governance and security layer for modern AI\-native development:
+ Docker MCP Gateway: policy enforcement for MCP tool calls in agentic AI development workflows
+ Docker AI Governance (GA May 2026\): model lifecycle management, AI workload governance, and compliance controls
+ Docker Hardened Images (DHI): secure, continuously patched base images for AI model serving and application containers
+ Docker Sandbox (SBX): free microVM\-based agent isolation for developer\-facing AI coding workflows

* Guide customers in implementing AI governance controls across their SDLC, with particular focus on securing agentic development environments.
* Act as a subject matter expert on secure software supply chain, container security, and AI security trends in customer\-facing and community engagements.
* Provide architectural guidance for policy\-as\-code enforcement, identity and access governance for AI workloads, and SBOM visibility.
* Develop reusable technical assets — workshops, demos, and reference architectures — to scale impact across the channel and direct accounts.
* Advocate for India customer and partner needs with Product and Engineering, providing structured feedback from field experience.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, or Developer Advocate in a technical sales or community\-facing role.
* Familiarity with AI security, AI governance frameworks, or secure software supply chain practices. Direct experience with agentic AI development workflows is a plus.
* Solid understanding of containers, DevOps, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and modern application architectures.
* Comfortable operating across both enterprise customer engagements and developer community contexts.
* Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience with partner or channel selling motions, co\-selling with resellers, SIs, or distributors, or running partner enablement programs.
* Familiarity with India's enterprise technology landscape, including IT services companies, large SIs, and the startup/scale\-up segment.
* Willingness to travel domestically across India's major tech hubs, with occasional travel to Southeast Asia (primarily Singapore) for regional coverage.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies.
* Public speaking, developer advocacy, conference presenting, or technical content creation experience.
* Familiarity with agentic AI development, MCP tooling, or AI governance frameworks.
* Experience running competitive PoCs/PoVs with clearly defined success and exit criteria.
* Understanding of India\-specific compliance requirements, including DPDP Act, CERT\-In, RBI, and MeitY.
* Familiarity with India's IT services and SI ecosystem.


**What To Expect**
 First 30 Days
   

  

* Onboarding with equipment setup, Docker tools training (Salesforce, Opine, Sigma), and peer pairing with the broader APAC SE team.
* Meet key channel partner contacts, SI leads, and distributor relationships across India.
* Review open pipeline, account history, and any pending handovers from prior SE coverage.
* Begin building familiarity with Docker's AI portfolio: MCP Gateway, AI Gov, DHI, and SBX.


 First 60 Days
   

  

* Deliver first partner enablement session with a key channel partner or SI.
* Engage actively with strategic accounts and participate in live customer opportunities.
* Develop a view of the India community calendar and identify a first speaking or content opportunity.
* Gain in\-depth knowledge of Docker products and how they map to Indian customer priorities.


 First 90 Days
   

  

* Operating independently across partner, customer, and community motions.
* First community content piece or event appearance confirmed or delivered.
* Clear account handover completed and relationships established at key strategic accounts.
* Contributing to the India SE coverage plan and providing product feedback from the field.


***Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.***
**Perks**
* Freedom \& flexibility; fit your work around your life
* Designated quarterly Whaleness Days plus end of year Whaleness break
* Home office setup; we want you comfortable while you work
* 16 weeks of paid Parental leave (after 6 months of employment)
* Technology stipend equivalent to $100 USD net/month
* PTO plan that encourages you to take time to do the things you enjoy
* Training stipend for conferences, courses and classes
* Equity; we are a growing start\-up and want all employees to have a share in the success of the company
* Docker Swag
* Medical benefits, retirement and holidays vary by country
* Remote\-first culture, with offices in Seattle and Paris


 Docker embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our company will be.

9b815ce3.title: Lead II - Enterprise Solutions
9b815ce3.description:
**Role description**  

Looking for a proactive and self\-sufficient SAP Technical Consultant with strong experience in ECC to S/4HANA conversion projects. The candidate should be capable of understanding and addressing code\-level differences between ECC and S/4, interpreting ETC/ATC outcomes, and supporting functional teams with remediation recommendations. This role requires someone who can work independently, take ownership, and bring continuous improvement ideas to the project. Key Responsibilities: Analyze Custom Code Migration (ATC/ETC) results and identify S/4HANA\-impact areas. Understand key ECC\-to\-S/4 code changes (e.g., SELECT SINGLE without unique key SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS, binary search with proper sorting, obsolete table replacements, etc.). Identify non\-supported tables, function modules, or obsolete constructs and propose S/4\-compliant alternatives. Collaborate with functional teams to interpret findings and define technical remediation approaches. Support SPDD/SPAU activities and ensure all custom objects are aligned post\-conversion. Review RICEF objects for compatibility and ensure clean migration readiness. Provide technical guidance, clear communication, and drive closure without repeated follow\-ups. Must\-Have Skills: 6\-10 years of SAP ABAP experience, with hands\-on exposure to S/4HANA conversion projects. Strong understanding of typical ECC\-to\-S/4 code adaptation scenarios and why these changes are required. Experience with ATC setup, running checks, interpreting simplification items, and handling technical remediation. Knowledge of SPDD/SPAU adjustments and their impact on custom developments. Ability to explain technical findings to functional teams clearly and confidently. Good to Have (Optional): Familiarity with HANA\-optimized coding, CDS Views, and modern ABAP syntax. Exposure to RAP, OData, or Fiori extensions. Basic knowledge of performance tuning on HANA DB. Behavioral Expectations: Self\-driven \& accountable takes complete ownership of assigned areas, drives progress without constant follow\-up. Proactive contributor identifies potential improvement or risk areas and brings them to attention early. Collaborative communicator works seamlessly with functional and cross teams. Quality\-focused ensures every deliverable aligns with SAP S/4HANA best practices.

 **Skills**  

SAP ABAP, SAP Basis, SAP Fiori, SAP S/4HANA, OData, SAP HANA, SAP ECC

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

 4 10 Years

 Full\-Time

 Bengaluru,Kolkata,

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant** 
 to design, implement, and optimize Salesforce Data Cloud solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with customer data integration, identity resolution, segmentation, calculated insights, and activation across Salesforce clouds. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable, data\-driven customer engagement solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain Salesforce Data Cloud solutions.

* Integrate Salesforce Data Cloud with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, CRM Analytics, and external systems.
* Configure data ingestion from various sources using APIs, MuleSoft, ETL tools, or native connectors.
* Monitor data quality, governance, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot integration and data processing issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure security, compliance, and data privacy best practices are followed.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Salesforce Data Cloud (Customer Data Platform)
* Data Streams, Data Lake Objects (DLO), Data Model Objects (DMO)
* Identity Resolution and Unified Profiles
* Segmentation and Activation
* Calculated Insights
* Data Mapping and Data Transformations
* Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud integration
* Marketing Cloud integration
* SOQL and Salesforce Platform fundamentals
* REST/SOAP APIs
* Data modeling and ETL concepts
* SQL


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* CRM Analytics (Tableau CRM)
* MuleSoft
* Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS/Azure data platforms
* Python
* Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs)


 Required Experience

* Experience implementing enterprise\-scale Salesforce Data Cloud solutions.

* Experience integrating Salesforce with third\-party systems.


 Preferred Certifications
   

  

* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Administrator
* Salesforce Platform App Builder
* Salesforce AI Associate (preferred)

 Order to Cash \- Account Management

 Delivery Lead Manager

 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. Order to Cash is the complete process from receiving a customer order to collecting payment. It includes order management, credit management, invoicing, and payment processing. The goal is to ensure efficient and accurate handling of orders and timely collection of revenue. This process helps improve cash flow and customer satisfaction. Effective Order to Cash management is crucial for a companys financial health and operational efficiency keyword includes :\- ("Order to Cash","Cash App","Collection \& Dispute",Billing, "Deduction") Implement client account plans through relationship development and opportunity pursuits that builds deeper client relationships. Includes monitoring existing services to identify opportunities that provide additional and innovative value to the client.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Manage day to day operations for OTC \- Technical know how of OTC domain involving Cash Applications, Deductions, Customer Master Data, and Reconciliations for Account receivables to be able to understand and resolve issues pragmatically \- Deliver smooth transitions (first time right) \- Enable robust governance and surprise free delivery \- Manage stakeholders and establish strong business relationship \- Manage team of :50 people and coordinate with support functions for seamless delivery \- Ensure delivery as per SLA/KPI targets and stays proactive on delivery/commitments/issue management Strong domain with exposure to JDE environment \- Should be able to guide teams in complex situations \- People Management \- Know how of most commonly use tools in OTC (like Matching tool for Cash Apps, Workflow, etc.) NA
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
* In this role you are required to identify and assess complex problems for area of responsibility
* The person would create solutions in situations in which analysis requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors
* Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near\-term goals
* Interaction of the individual is with senior management at a client and/or within Accenture, involving matters that may require acceptance of an alternate approach
* Some latitude in decision\-making in involved
* you will act independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments
* Decisions individual at this role makes have a major day to day impact on area of responsibility
* The person manages large \- medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts, Any Graduation

dbf3665b.title: Delivery Lead Manager
dbf3665b.description:
**Skill required:** 
 Financial Planning \& Analysis \- Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A)
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Delivery Lead Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 BCom/MCom/Master of Business Administration
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 The Senior ASP – plays a critical role in connecting enterprise strategy, market volatility, and operational execution across Fonterra’s business. This role is responsible for Partnering with BU’s as necessary leading performance frameworks both Reporting and forward looking , driving forward\-looking analysis, and embedding integrated performance management. Drawing on experience in consumer goods, retail grocery and wholesale, liquor industry (Dairy, oil \& gas, grain, mining, energy or chemicals), this role brings deep understanding of cost drivers, margin volatility, capacity constraints, market risk, manufacturing, supply chain, product costing and capital allocation tradeoffs. The role provides strategic insights to understand past performance and drive future performance, scenario modelling and decision support to executive stakeholders, ensuring financial and operational performance are tightly aligned to strategic objectives and market realities.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Qualifications required Graduate/Post degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting preferred. CA/ICWA/CPA is not required, but it is preferred. Skills, knowledge, experience required
   

  

* 10\+ years’ experience in Commercial Portfolio Management, FP\&A, Business Performance, or Commercial Finance within a commodity\-based environment such as oil \& gas, grocery retail/wholesale/liquor store, grain/soft commodities, mining, metals, CPG, Beverages, manufacturing, banking or energy markets Deep commercial \& operational understanding
* Experience working with commodity markets, price curves, hedging, supply/demand analytics, or trading.
* Understanding of global supply chains, production economics, and asset intensive operations.
* Experience connecting financial performance with operational and market drivers. Advanced analytical \& modelling capability
* Strong skills in scenario modelling, cost curves, sensitivity analysis, optimisation models, and price\-volume\-mix.
* Experience with advanced analytics or forecasting tools used in commodity industries. Systems \& digital capability
* Advanced Excel — financial modelling, large datasets, pivot analysis, complex lookups
* SAP ECC or equivalent ERP — report extraction, cost centre mapping, GL cod 6\. Enterprise Reporting, Data \& Systems
* Support the Finance Business Partner, FP\&A Manager, Divisional General Manager in team leadership, planning, and execution of key initiatives.
* Lead adoption of enterprise CPM tools (SAP SAC, Power BI, or equivalent).
* Build reporting for trading, and product contribution margin.
* Ensure data quality, , and single\-source\-of\-truth structures for performance reporting. 7\. Leadership \& Influence
* Lead cross\-functional performance dialogues, including monthly performance reviews, risk reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Coach analysts and stakeholders on interpreting commodity driven performance drivers. driven performance drivers.
* Mentor wider FP\&A and operational finance teams in understanding margin dynamics and drivers of volatility.
* Partner to drive long term outcomes for the Business Roles and Responsibilities:
* 1\. Strategic Performance Frameworks
* Working with Finance ensure alignment of long term and near term plans
* Lead development and continuous improvement of the enterprise performance management (IBP) framework, ensuring alignment across Trading, Operations, Logistics, Manufacturing, and Commercial functions.
* Translate commodity market movements, input cost volatility, FX impacts, and supply chain constraints into actionable performance insights for senior leaders.
* Drive standardisation of planning, performance and reporting processes across the business units. 2\. Market \& Margin Analytics
* Drive overall understanding of drivers and insights into Performance including Margins
* Margin Analytics \- Produce margin per unit / margin per product analysis incorporating commodity price curves, cost curves, and market supply/demand dynamics
* Integrate operational KPIs (yield, throughput, energy use, working capital) with Sales and Optimisation financial KPIs to create a unified performance view.
* Provide insights into Optimisation (swing) decisions (e.g., product mix optimisation, channel allocation, plant utilisation). 3\. Scenario Analysis \& Decision Support
* Lead complex multi\-variable scenario modelling (commodity prices, global demand, weather impacts, geopolitical shifts, supply disruptions).
* Support strategic investment decisions including capacity expansions, asset maintenance cycles, and capital optimisation.
* Run sensitivities for pricing, cost shocks, operational disruptions, and supply\-chain changes.
* Provide clear financial narratives to support decision\-making at leadership levels. 4\. Performance Management
* Support target setting and KPI tracking for the business unit.
* Drive continuous performance monitoring, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Provide analytical support on revenue, cost, margin, working capital drivers, store forecasting, profitability analysis or occupancy on shelves
* Support cost recoveries through allocation models or charge backs from operations or other business units 5\. Integrated Business Planning (IBP)
* Ensure IBP integrates demand, supply, inventory, production planning and commercial strategy into a single enterprise plan.
* Critically evaluate plan assumptions using demand forecasts, commodity price outlooks, cost curves and market intelligence.
* Ensure alignment between financial plan, S\&OP, and operational plans—especially in volatile market environments., BCom,MCom,Master of Business Administration
