2d5555c1.title: Presales Specialist
2d5555c1.description:
**Role Title:** 
 Pre Sales Specialist
 



**Role Vertical:** 
 Conversational AI 
 



**Years of Experience:** 
 5\-8 years
 



**Base Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Preferred Industry:** 
 Conversational AI, enterprise chatbots, Contact Center Automation, CPaaS, SaaS or customer\-experience platforms
 



**Minimum Qualification:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. An MBA would be an advantage.
 



  





**About Fonada** 




 Fonada is an enterprise communication and customer\-engagement company offering CPaaS, cloud telephony, messaging and AI\-powered communication solutions.
 



 Through Fonada and FonadaLabs, we are building advanced Conversational AI solutions—including AI chatbots, voice bots, speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, multilingual AI, voice cloning and speech analytics. These solutions help enterprises automate customer support, lead qualification, sales outreach, appointment booking, collections, onboarding and other high\-volume customer interactions.
 



**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales Specialist – Conversational AI who can understand enterprise customer requirements and translate them into technically viable and commercially compelling solutions.
 



 The incumbent will work closely with Sales, Product, AI/ML, Engineering, Project Management and Customer Success teams. The role will cover customer discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, effort estimation, proof\-of\-concept execution and technical closure of sales opportunities.
 



 The position requires business understanding, consultative selling ability, Conversational AI knowledge and sufficient technical depth to engage confidently with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, contact\-centre heads and IT teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Discovery and Requirement Analysis** 



* Participate in customer meetings to understand business objectives, processes, pain points and automation opportunities.
* Identify use cases suitable for AI chatbots, voice bots or integrated omnichannel solutions.
* Understand conversation volumes, languages, channels, integrations, security requirements and expected business outcomes.
* Conduct discovery workshops with business, operations, contact\-centre and technology stakeholders.
* Prepare requirement documents, process flows, use\-case summaries and solution scope documents.
* Differentiate between standard, configurable and custom\-development requirements.



**Solution Design** 



* Design end\-to\-end chatbot and voice\-bot solutions aligned with customer requirements.
* Map conversation journeys, intents, entities, prompts, knowledge sources, escalation rules, exception paths and human\-agent handovers.
* Recommend the appropriate combination of rule\-based workflows, NLP/NLU, generative AI, RAG and API\-driven automation.
* Design solutions for websites, mobile applications, WhatsApp, RCS and other customer\-engagement channels.
* Incorporate FonadaLabs’ speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, multilingual AI, speech analytics and related capabilities where relevant.
* Define integrations with CRM, ERP, contact\-centre, ticketing, payment, database and knowledge\-management platforms.
* Prepare high\-level solution architecture, data\-flow diagrams and API requirements.



**Demonstrations and Presentations** 



* Deliver product demonstrations tailored to the customer’s industry and business requirements.
* Configure demonstration bots, conversation journeys and sample knowledge bases.
* Present Fonada’s Conversational AI capabilities to business and technical stakeholders.
* Explain solution capabilities, limitations, implementation requirements and business benefits clearly.
* Develop industry\-specific use cases for sectors such as BFSI, healthcare, education, real estate, e\-commerce, travel and logistics.
* Support sales teams during customer presentations, workshops and industry events.



**Proposals, RFPs and Commercial Support** 



* Prepare technical proposals, statements of work, solution notes and implementation plans.
* Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical questionnaires.
* Clearly define scope, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, deliverables and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams to estimate effort, timelines and resources.
* Support pricing based on conversations, users, channels, API usage, integrations and development effort.
* Build ROI\-based business cases covering cost reduction, agent productivity, conversion improvement and customer experience.
* Identify delivery, technical and commercial risks before commitments are made.



**Proof of Concept and Technical Closure** 



* Define POC scope, success criteria, timelines and responsibilities.
* Coordinate with Product, AI/ML and Engineering teams for POC delivery.
* Analyse POC results and present recommendations to customer stakeholders.
* Address technical objections, integration questions and information\-security requirements.
* Drive opportunities towards technical closure and commercial conversion.



**Sales\-to\-Delivery Handover** 



* Ensure that the solution sold is clearly documented and practically deliverable.
* Conduct detailed handovers to Project Management, Implementation and Customer Success teams.
* Transfer all agreed requirements, integrations, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria.
* Support the implementation team in resolving requirement\-related issues during the initial deployment stage.
* Minimise gaps between pre\-sales commitments and final delivery.



**Product and Sales Enablement** 



* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams based on customer needs and market trends.
* Track developments in Conversational AI, generative AI, LLMs, agentic AI and contact\-centre automation.
* Monitor competing platforms and contribute to Fonada’s competitive positioning.
* Create reusable discovery questionnaires, proposals, architecture diagrams, industry solutions and demonstration scripts.
* Train the sales team on use cases, product capabilities, qualification criteria and competitive differentiation.



**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. An MBA would be an advantage.
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including at least 3 years in pre\-sales, solution consulting, product consulting or solution architecture.
* Experience with Conversational AI, enterprise chatbots, contact\-centre automation, CPaaS, SaaS or customer\-experience platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience preparing proposals, RFP responses, statements of work and technical presentations.
* Experience delivering enterprise product demonstrations and managing POCs.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs and enterprise integrations.
* Understanding of CRM, ERP, ticketing, contact\-centre and knowledge\-management systems.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, NLP/NLU, intents, entities and conversational design.
* Basic understanding of cloud architecture, authentication, data security and enterprise deployment models.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and workshops when required.



**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience with platforms such as Google Dialogflow, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Amazon Lex, Kore.ai, Yellow.ai, Haptik, Gupshup, Rasa or equivalent.
* Exposure to WhatsApp Business, RCS, web chat, mobile\-app chat and omnichannel engagement.
* Understanding of AI voice bots, ASR, TTS and telephony integrations.
* Experience with multilingual use cases and Indian enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with data protection, consent, auditability and responsible\-AI requirements.
* Experience developing business cases and ROI models for automation projects.



**Key Competencies** 



* Consultative and solution\-oriented approach
* Strong customer\-facing presence
* Business\-process understanding
* Conversational solution design
* Technical and integration aptitude
* Commercial acumen
* Presentation and storytelling skills
* Stakeholder management
* Problem\-solving and attention to detail
* Strong ownership and execution discipline



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Number and value of qualified opportunities supported
* Technical\-closure and sales\-conversion rates
* Quality and turnaround time of proposals and RFP responses
* Number and success rate of demonstrations and POCs
* Accuracy of solution scope, timelines and effort estimates
* Reduction in sales\-to\-delivery requirement gaps
* Customer and internal stakeholder feedback
* Contribution to reusable solutions and sales\-enablement assets



**Ideal Candidate** 




 The ideal candidate can understand a customer’s business problem, identify where Conversational AI can create measurable value, design an effective solution and confidently present it to business and technology stakeholders.
 




 The candidate should be comfortable discussing customer journeys and ROI with business leaders while also discussing APIs, integrations, architecture and security with IT teams. The person must be commercially aware and disciplined about making commitments that Fonada can implement and scale successfully.

097fac2c.title: Architect
097fac2c.company: La Dylunio Empresa POC Pvt. Ltd.
097fac2c.description:
Architect – Design \& Execution Lead

**Location:** Canacona, South Goa  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, In\-house  
**Work Environment:** Office \+ Active Project Sites  
**Relocation:** Mandatory

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, hands\-on Architect to join our in\-house design and execution team in South Goa.

This is not a conventional architecture\-office role.

You will work closely with the Founder on multiple hospitality, residential, landscape and experimental construction projects across South Goa, converting ideas and concepts into practical, buildable and visually distinctive spaces.

The role requires someone who enjoys being equally comfortable with a sketchbook, CAD drawings, materials, contractors, fabricators and active construction sites.

We are particularly interested in architects who want to experiment with sustainable construction, alternative materials, modular systems and unconventional architectural ideas.

You should be someone who wants to **build**, not merely design.

Key ResponsibilitiesDesign \& Concept Development

* Work directly with the Founder to develop architectural concepts and spatial ideas.
* Translate sketches, references and conceptual ideas into practical architectural solutions.
* Prepare plans, elevations, sections, details and working drawings.
* Develop design options based on site conditions, budgets and execution constraints.
* Participate in master planning, architectural planning, interiors, landscape integration and site development.
* Develop designs that respond intelligently to the tropical and coastal conditions of Goa.

Design Development \& Technical Coordination

* Convert concepts into detailed, construction\-ready drawings.
* Coordinate with the Structural Engineer, CAD/BIM team, MEP consultants and site teams.
* Resolve architectural and structural coordination issues before execution.
* Prepare and review construction details, junctions, sections and material specifications.
* Maintain proper drawing revisions and ensure the site is always working with current drawings.
* Assist in preparing as\-built drawings and documentation.

Site Execution

A significant portion of this role will be site\-based.

You will be expected to:

* Regularly visit and supervise project sites.
* Explain architectural intent and drawings to contractors and workers.
* Resolve design and execution issues directly on site.
* Coordinate with contractors, carpenters, welders, plumbers, electricians, fabricators and other trades.
* Check dimensions, levels, finishes and construction quality.
* Ensure the final execution remains faithful to the design.
* Identify problems early and develop practical solutions rather than allowing work to stop unnecessarily.
* Take ownership of projects from concept through execution.

Material Research \& Innovation

We actively experiment with materials and construction techniques.

The Architect will be expected to research and explore:

* Bamboo
* Engineered timber
* FRP and composite materials
* Structural steel
* Modular construction
* Container\-based architecture
* Lightweight structures
* Natural and biodegradable materials
* Reclaimed materials
* Local stone and laterite
* Alternative roofing and façade systems
* Coastal and corrosion\-resistant construction techniques

You do not need to already be an expert in every material.

You do need to have the curiosity and technical discipline to learn.

Vendor \& Contractor Coordination

* Identify and coordinate with specialist vendors and fabricators.
* Obtain technical information and samples.
* Compare materials, systems and execution methods.
* Assist with quotations and material selection.
* Coordinate mock\-ups and prototypes where required.
* Work closely with procurement and site teams.

What We Are Looking ForQualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent recognised qualification.
* COA registration preferred.

Experience

Ideally 3**–7 years of practical architectural experience**.

Exceptional younger candidates with strong portfolios and substantial site exposure may also be considered.

Technical Skills

Strong working knowledge of:

* AutoCAD
* SketchUp

Experience with one or more of the following will be strongly preferred:

* Revit
* Rhino
* Lumion
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* V\-Ray
* BIM workflows

You should be capable of independently developing architectural drawings rather than depending entirely on a draughtsman.

The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely passionate about architecture and construction.
* Wants to create extraordinary work rather than repetitive commercial projects.
* Is comfortable working on active construction sites.
* Can communicate effectively with workers, contractors and specialist consultants.
* Has strong attention to detail.
* Thinks practically about how something will actually be built.
* Enjoys experimentation and problem\-solving.
* Is curious about new materials and technologies.
* Is comfortable challenging conventional construction methods where better solutions exist.
* Can take ownership rather than waiting continuously for instructions.
* Can work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment.
* Is comfortable working directly with the Founder.
* Is ambitious and wants substantially greater responsibility over time.

We particularly value people whose first response to an unusual architectural challenge is:

**"Let's figure out how to build it."**

rather than:

**"This is not normally done."**

Career Opportunity

This role is intended to become much larger than that of a conventional project architect.

The right person will have the opportunity to gradually take responsibility for the organisation's **Design \& Architecture Vertical**, working across multiple projects and building an in\-house architecture, engineering and execution capability.

You will work alongside:

* Structural Engineers
* CAD/BIM Designers
* Skilled trades
* Contractors
* Fabricators
* MEP specialists
* Material suppliersThe objective is to create a highly capable internal team that can take projects from:

**Idea → Design → Engineering → Drawings → Procurement → Construction → Completion**

Location \& Mobility

The position is based in **Canacona, South Goa**.

Our projects are currently located across areas including:

* Agonda
* Cabo de Rama
* Talpona
* Other locations across South Goa

Regular travel between project sites will be required.

Candidates should ideally have their **own two\-wheeler or vehicle** for local travel.

Candidates currently living outside South Goa must be willing to **relocate to Canacona**.

This Role May Not Be For You If

* You are looking primarily for a desk\-based architectural position.
* You prefer only conceptual design and do not enjoy execution.
* You are uncomfortable dealing directly with contractors and workers.
* You require highly defined boundaries around your responsibilities.
* You are uncomfortable with experimentation or unconventional construction.
* You prefer repetitive residential/commercial drafting over solving new design problems.

This Role Could Be For You If

You want to look back five years from now and point to buildings, structures and spaces across South Goa and say:

**"I helped imagine that, engineer it, draw it and actually build it."**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Support UAT, go\-live planning, post\-launch transition, and customer feedback collection.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading client meetings, discovery sessions, workshops, or implementation calls.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations with defined timelines and deliverables.
* Strong consultative skills, including active listening, requirements clarification, expectation management, and solution recommendation.

Role
Sr Solution Consultant
Why UKG:


At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.


We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  

  

Sr. Solution Consultant –


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead customer\-facing implementation activities for HRSD solutions including Document Manager and People Assist.
* Facilitate kickoff, discovery, requirements, configuration, testing, and go\-live readiness sessions.
* Guide customers through standard and premium launch methodologies, including accelerated out\-of\-the\-box implementations and more complex enterprise implementations.
* Translate customer business needs into practical configuration recommendations using predefined templates, roles, workflows, and best practices.
* Support role mapping, SSO coordination, integration readiness, tenant setup, and UKG Pro integration alignment.
* Help customers understand product capabilities, prerequisite training, and implementation expectations.
* Manage scope boundaries clearly, including identifying out\-of\-scope items such as advanced customization, mass document ingestion, mass signature generation, or post\-go\-live service requests.
* Partner with internal technical, integration, support, and escalation teams to resolve implementation issues.
* Support document migration activities, including category mapping, sync enablement, migration readiness, and issue troubleshooting.
* Conduct workshops focused on practical use cases, customer enablement, and self\-service adoption.
* Support UAT, go\-live planning, post\-launch transition, and customer feedback collection.
* Maintain clear communication, project documentation, status updates, risks, actions, and next steps.
* Work effectively with customers of varying complexity, including enterprise and global rollout scenarios.

**Required Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of experience in consulting, SaaS implementation, HR technology implementation, professional services, or customer\-facing delivery.
* Strong experience leading client meetings, discovery sessions, workshops, or implementation calls.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations with defined timelines and deliverables.
* Strong consultative skills, including active listening, requirements clarification, expectation management, and solution recommendation.
* Experience working with implementation methodologies such as kickoff, analysis, configuration, testing/UAT, and go\-live.
* Ability to understand business processes and translate them into system configuration or implementation steps.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage HR, IT, payroll, operations, and leadership stakeholders.
* Comfortable working with project plans, playbooks, templates, best\-practice guides, and internal knowledge resources.
* Ability to identify risks, blockers, and scope gaps early and escalate appropriately.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with HR Service Delivery, case management, employee document management, knowledge management, or employee self\-service solutions.
* Experience with HRIS/HCM platforms such as UKG Pro, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, ServiceNow HRSD, or similar systems.
* Familiarity with SSO, integrations, tenant setup, role\-based permissions, workflow configuration, or document migration.
* Experience supporting enterprise, multi\-country, or phased rollouts.
* Understanding of data privacy or compliance considerations such as GDPR.
* Experience in professional services, implementation consulting, customer success, or business process consulting.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**


This person should be a confident consultant who can bring structure to ambiguity, guide customers through a defined implementation process, and maintain healthy scope boundaries. They do not need to be a product expert on day one, but they should be able to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and help customers adopt best practices instead of over\-customizing too early.


**Success Measures**


* Customers are prepared, trained, and clear on implementation expectations.
* Launches are delivered within agreed timelines and scope.
* Customer requirements are captured accurately and translated into practical configuration.
* Risks, dependencies, and out\-of\-scope requests are identified early.
* Customers feel guided, enabled, and ready for go\-live.
* Internal handoffs to support or post\-implementation teams are clean and well documented.
  

  

If you are a seasoned professional with a passion for workforce management and a track record of delivering high\-quality solutions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and be a part of our exciting journey at UKG!

635455cd.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD

* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems

* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. 8c41d657.title: Solution Architect – Power Platform Migration (Tenant-to-Tenant)
8c41d657.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**The Role:**  

You will be the **Power Platform discipline Solution Architect** for a global tenant\-to\-tenant M365 consolidation, responsible for defining and governing the migration approach for **Power Apps, Power Automate, environments, Dataverse usage where applicable, governance controls and remediation patterns** .


Power Platform tenant moves are not “lift and shift”. The complexity sits in **connections, identity, environment strategy, DLP, ALM, solution packaging, ownership transitions, service principals and post\-move remediation** . You will design the migration blueprint, set factory runbooks and lead escalations to protect business\-critical apps and automations across waves.


**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define the **Power Platform target\-state architecture** for the consolidated tenant: environment strategy, governance model, ALM approach, security model, connector strategy.
* Define the tenant\-to\-tenant migration approach: discovery, classification (criticality), packaging strategy (solutions), pre\-move remediation, move execution, post\-move validation and fix patterns.
* Establish runbooks and gates for: connection reference remediation, ownership transitions, environment settings alignment, DLP policy alignment and managed/unmanaged solution handling.
* Define how the factory identifies and remediates common issues: broken connections, consent issues, connector availability differences, environment variable mismatches, policy blocks.
* Coordinate dependencies with Identity/Entra Apps discipline: for consent/SSO/service principal remediation patterns, app registrations, service principals, API permissions, admin consent, conditional access.
* Define validation and acceptance criteria that are meaningful: functional smoke tests for high\-impact apps/flows, business sign\-off artefacts, rollback/recovery guidance.
* Govern exceptions and technical debt: what can be deferred, what must be fixed before cutover and what requires business acceptance of risk.
* Drive telemetry/reporting: defect categories, remediation throughput, rework rate, top blockers and continuous improvement backlog.

  

**Who You Are**

**Must‑Have:**  

* Proven delivery of **tenant\-to\-tenant Power Platform migration** in production (Power Apps \+ Power Automate) , must be demonstrated.
* Strong Power Platform architecture experience: environments, solutions, governance/DLP, security roles, connector strategy, operational support.
* Experience diagnosing and remediating migration defects at scale (connections, ownership, consent, ALM/solution issues).
* Ability to produce factory\-grade runbooks, quality gates, evidence packs and repeatable remediation patterns.
* Strong stakeholder management with app owners and business SMEs; can protect business outcomes without allowing uncontrolled exceptions.

**Good‑to‑Have:**  

* Dataverse experience (security roles, capacity considerations, integration patterns).
* Experience with PP ALM pipelines / DevOps integration.

**Interpersonal \& Consulting Skills:**  

* Can lead with clarity: sets standards, explains trade\-offs and drives compliance.
* Calm and decisive in cutover windows; can run technical war rooms and close issues fast.
* Strong coaching behaviours: turns recurring problems into standard patterns and templates.
* Communicates risk in business terms; avoids “it depends” without options and recommendations.

**Shift / Working Pattern Notes:**  

* This role operates within a **three‑shift 24x7 Factory model** . The specific rota will be confirmed, but **shift handovers are mandatory** and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The IT\&D Manager, ServiceNow Solution Architect is responsible for designing and governing end\-to\-end ServiceNow solutions that underpin the GBS Operating System. The role ensures that ServiceNow capabilities are designed in a scalable, secure, AI\-enabled and user\-centric way, enabling consistent service experiences across Finance, Procurement, HR and Supply services.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Own solution design and architecture for ServiceNow capabilities supporting the GBS Operating System
* Design ServiceNow solutions across service management, service catalogue, knowledge management and portal experiences
* Lead solution design for Finance\-related ServiceNow modules and workflows, ensuring alignment to service, control and compliance requirements
* Design and govern AI\-enabled ServiceNow capabilities supporting GBS, including conversational catalogues, virtual agents and agentic workflows
* Define architectural patterns, guardrails and governance for the safe, scalable and responsible use of AI within ServiceNow
* Monitor the performance, effectiveness and adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities, ensuring they deliver intended outcomes


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Extensive experience designing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow service management, service catalogue, knowledge and portal capabilities
* Experience designing finance or business service workflows on enterprise platforms
* Demonstrated experience integrating enterprise platforms with third\-party systems
* Experience designing front\-end ServiceNow experiences using Service Portal and/or UI Builder
* Exposure to AI, automation or conversational service capabilities in enterprise platforms


 The skills for success
   

  

 ServiceNow Architecture, Stakeholder Management, ServiceNow Solutions, GBS
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

1f8720a8.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
1f8720a8.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

4b341837.title: Cloud Engineer
4b341837.description:
**Company Description** 
 AI Vidya is a training and career enablement organization focused on developing future leaders in artificial intelligence. The company provides personalized AI training programs designed to help individuals build practical, industry\-relevant skills. With dedicated job assistance and expert guidance, AI Vidya supports learners throughout their career journey in the digital age. The organization emphasizes confidence\-building, skill mastery, and ongoing mentorship to help participants thrive in the fast\-paced world of AI. Joining AI Vidya means being part of a community that aims to lead and innovate in the evolving AI landscape.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote Cloud Engineer role. The Cloud Engineer will design, build, and maintain cloud\-based infrastructure to support AI Vidya’s training platforms and internal systems. Responsibilities include implementing scalable and secure cloud solutions, managing Linux\-based servers, configuring and monitoring databases, and optimizing performance and reliability across environments. The role involves collaborating with software development teams to deploy applications, automate workflows, and improve CI/CD pipelines. The Cloud Engineer will also troubleshoot production issues, implement best practices for security and cost optimization, and contribute to documentation and operational standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Cloud Computing and Infrastructure, including experience with major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Proficiency in Linux administration and systems management, including monitoring, security hardening, and automation using shell scripting or similar tools.
* Hands\-on experience with Databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), including configuration, performance tuning, backup strategies, and high availability.
* Software Development skills with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git).
* Understanding of networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, load balancers, firewalls) and cloud security best practices.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and prior exposure to AI or data platforms is a plus.

bde995ec.title: Cloud Security Detection Engineer (SIEM, SOAR & Automation)
bde995ec.description:
About the Organization
 



 We are a global technology company operating large\-scale internet platforms and cloud\-based services used by millions of customers worldwide. Our Technology Management organization provides enterprise technology governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management capabilities that enable secure innovation across diverse business units and regions.
 



 Within our cybersecurity function, the Cyber Security Defense team is responsible for protecting products, infrastructure, and users against a constantly evolving threat landscape. The team combines secure engineering, threat detection, incident response, and security operations to defend critical production environments and strengthen overall cyber resilience.
 



 The Opportunity
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cloud Security Detection \& Automation Engineer** 
 to design and build the detection and response capabilities that underpin our modern security operations program.
 



 This position sits at the intersection of Security Operations, Cloud Security, Detection Engineering, and Security Automation. You will be responsible for developing advanced detection content, creating security automation workflows, and building engineering solutions that improve visibility, response speed, and overall security effectiveness across a large global hybrid\-cloud environment.
 



 The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex security challenges through engineering and automation rather than manual processes and is passionate about building scalable security capabilities.
 



 What You Will Be Doing
 



 Detection Engineering
 


* Create, enhance, and optimize detection content across SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms.
* Develop high\-confidence detection rules that identify malicious or suspicious activity across cloud, containerized, and virtualized environments.
* Map detections to recognized threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Continuously improve detection coverage while minimizing false positives.



 Security Automation \& Response
 


* Design and implement security orchestration and automated response workflows (SOAR).
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce analyst workload.
* Develop automated remediation and containment actions for common threat scenarios.
* Improve detection\-to\-response timelines through intelligent automation.



 Cloud \& Infrastructure Security
 


* Secure and monitor hybrid cloud environments spanning public cloud and private infrastructure.
* Build automated mechanisms to assess cloud security posture and detect configuration drift.
* Strengthen security controls across Kubernetes, virtualized systems, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Support continuous compliance initiatives through automation and monitoring.



 Security Engineering
 


* Develop custom security tools and integrations using Python, Go, or similar technologies.
* Leverage APIs and automation frameworks to improve security visibility and operational effectiveness.
* Engineer solutions that close capability gaps within the security technology ecosystem.
* Transform security requirements into scalable, code\-driven implementations.



 Collaboration \& Threat Analysis
 


* Partner closely with SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, and infrastructure teams to embed security controls into CI/CD workflows.
* Analyze logs, telemetry, network traffic, and system activity to uncover advanced threats and suspicious behaviors.
* Contribute technical expertise during investigations and incident response activities.
* Communicate findings and technical recommendations effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* 4\+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Detection Engineering
* Security Engineering
* Incident Response
* Security Operations
* Hands\-on experience securing cloud\-native, virtualized, or containerized environments.
* Practical experience with Kubernetes and at least one major cloud platform:
* AWS
* Azure
* GCP
* Strong programming ability in at least one of the following:
* Python
* Go
* Ruby
* Experience creating and maintaining detections within SIEM, EDR, or cloud security platforms.
* Demonstrated success in automating security processes through SOAR platforms or custom\-developed solutions.
* Strong understanding of:
* Network protocols
* Linux and Windows internals
* Modern web application architecture
* Ability to work effectively in a multinational environment with cross\-functional technical teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience building detections aligned to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD technologies such as:
* Jenkins
* GitLab CI
* GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with Security\-as\-Code methodologies.
* Experience implementing identity\-centric security controls.
* Knowledge of micro\-segmentation architectures.
* Industry certifications such as:
* GCIA
* GDAT
* Comparable security certifications

 NP\-Immediate/serving NP preferred
 



**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Sonata Software's AWS Cloud Practice is hiring a Pre\-Sales Solution Consultant to drive revenue across its six cloud GTM motions. You will be the technical bridge between Sonata's sales teams and enterprise customers — crafting winning proposals, building deal\-specific business cases, and responding to RFPs across migration, GenAI, modernisation, and managed services. This is a quota\-carrying, high\-visibility role reporting into the AWS Business team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Lead technical pre\-sales engagements end\-to\-end: discovery calls, customer workshops, solution briefings, and executive presentations.
* Develop differentiated solution propositions for cloud migration (MAP\-funded), GenAI/Bedrock, MS Workload Modernisation, MSP/ESS, and VMware transformation opportunities.
* Build compelling customer\-facing proposals, RFP responses, SoWs, and BoM/TCO models.
* Construct Financial Business Cases: quantify customer TCO savings, ROI, payback period, and benchmark against current on\-premises or competitor cloud spend.
* Work with AWS account teams (APO, Scale Partners) on co\-sell motions, deal registrations, and MAP/PPA opportunity structuring.
* Own the creation and maintenance of reusable proposal assets, pitch decks, and solution playbooks for each GTM motion.
* Manage the full bid cycle — from qualification through commercials and contract sign\-off — in partnership with the account manager.
* Conduct competitive analysis (AWS vs. Azure vs. GCP) and position Sonata's differentiated value proposition.
* Support the COE in codifying win patterns into solution accelerators, templates, and GTM collateral.
* Track and report deal pipeline, coverage ratios, and win/loss analysis to AWS Business leadership weekly.



  





**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED** 




 Strong working knowledge of:
 


* AWS compute, storage, network, security services
* Cloud migration tooling \& patterns (MGN, DMS, RVTools)
* AWS pricing model — on\-demand, Savings Plans, RIs
* MAP 2\.0 funding mechanics and deal registration
* PPA / EDP commercial constructs
* TCO modelling tools and financial analysis
* GenAI services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Q
* MSP / Managed Services delivery models



  




* Proficiency in proposal tools: PowerPoint, Excel (financial modelling), Word; Sonata brand standards.
* Ability to read and respond to complex enterprise RFPs across regulated industries.
* Understanding of AWS partner programs: APN, MAP, PPA, ACE pipeline, CPPO.
* Familiarity with DevOps, Kubernetes, and modern application architecture patterns.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* B.E. / B.Tech / MBA or equivalent; strong quantitative background.
* 6–14 years of experience in cloud pre\-sales, solutions consulting, or cloud architecture — minimum 4 years in AWS.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (mandatory); Professional preferred.
* Track record of winning cloud deals \> $1M TCV; experience in multi\-year managed services deals a strong plus.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication — able to influence CXO and CTO\-level stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen: able to structure pricing, discounts, and SLA\-backed proposals.



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* Experience with AWS Marketplace listings and CPPO pricing.
* Exposure to vertical industries: BFSI, Healthcare / Payer, Manufacturing, Retail.
* Prior experience working within APN (AWS Partner Network) ecosystem.
* Knowledge of competitive cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) for competitive displacement positioning.
* Exposure to co\-sell orchestration via AWS ACE (APN Customer Engagement) portal.

ecf09fda.title: Cloud Solution Architect – Applications
ecf09fda.description:
**JOB TITLE: Cloud Solution Architect – Applications** 




  





**PRIMARY FUNCTION:** 



* The Cloud Solution Architect – Applications is responsible for leading the design, delivery, and
* architecture of cloud\-native application solutions on AWS, leveraging services such as Amazon EKS, AWS, Lambda, API Gateway, AWS CDK, and Amazon Bedrock.
* This individual demonstrates strong technical leadership, deep cloud architecture expertise, and a service\-oriented mindset to deliver scalable, secure and modern application platforms.
* Responsibilities include defining application architecture strategy, standards, governance, and best
* practices, ensuring alignment with enterprise cloud strategy.
* This role collaborates with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, modernize, and optimize applications leveraging microservices, serverless and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* The architect ensures solutions are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost optimized, while
* supporting enterprise digital transformation initiatives and long\-term architecture goals.



  





**SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY:** 




 Will lead architecture and provide technical guidance to a team of engineers and developers
 



 across application platforms.
 



  





**SPECIFIC DUTIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 



* Application Architecture \& Cloud Design.
* Define and maintain enterprise application architecture using AWS services including EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, CDK, and Bedrock.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud\-native solutions.
* Establish architecture patterns (microservices, serverless, API\-first, event\-driven).
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and cloud strategy.
* Cloud\-Native Application Enablement.
* Architect and guide implementation of container\-based applications using Amazon EKS Design serverless solutions using AWS Lambda and event\-driven patterns.
* Enable API\-driven architectures using API Gateway.
* Promote reusable frameworks and standard design patterns.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code adoption using AWS CDK.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployment.
* Promote GitOps practices for Kubernetes (EKS) environments.
* Design highly available, fault\-tolerant application architectures.
* Optimize performance and cost (auto\-scaling, compute optimization, concurrency control).
* Implement monitoring and observability using AWS\-native tools.
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and system health metrics.
* Data Lake Architecture \& Enablement.
* Design and implement data lake architectures for centralized storage of raw and diverse datasets.
* Enable schema\-on\-read and ELT\-based processing models to support flexible analytics and AI use cases.
* Support advanced use cases including machine learning, GenAI, and large\-scale analytics workloads.
* Ensure scalable and cost\-effective storage using cloud object storage platforms.
* Implement governance frameworks to prevent data quality issues and ensure discoverability.
* Ensure secure architecture using IAM, encryption, network isolation, and API security.
* Enforce authentication, authorization, and data protection standards.
* Align solutions with enterprise security policies and compliance requirements.
* Establish governance for application, API, and AI workloads.
* Ensure integrations comply with security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Enforce data privacy, encryption, and access control standards.
* Support audits by providing documentation, logs, and integration controls.
* Maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and architectural diagrams.



  





**BASIC QUALIFICIATIONS:** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience in related field
* 12\+ years of technical experience with cloud and application architecture
* 10\+ years of experience designing AWS\-based application solutions



  





**Strong experience with:** 



* Amazon EKS (Kubernetes)
* AWS Lambda (serverless architecture)
* API Gateway (API lifecycle management)
* AWS CDK (Infrastructure as Code)
* Amazon Bedrock (AI/GenAI application integration)
* Strong understanding of microservices, APIs (REST/GraphQL), and integration patterns
* Experience designing scalable, fault\-tolerant distributed systems
* Proven experience driving cloud\-native application modernization



  





**ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:** 



* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional preferred).
* Experience with event\-driven architectures (EventBridge, SQS, SNS).
* Strong knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, and automation practices.
* Experience integrating with enterprise systems (SAP, middleware platforms preferred).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in cross\-functional and global teams.
* Proven ability to drive large\-scale transformation initiatives.

408c754b.title: Solutions Architect
408c754b.description:
**About Company** 




  





 At
 **Celebal Technologies** 
 , we're shaping the future with cutting\-edge
 **AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Engineering** 
 solutions for global enterprises. As a trusted Microsoft and Databricks partner, we empower some of the world's leading organizations to solve complex business challenges through innovation. You'll get the opportunity to work on impactful, enterprise\-scale projects using the latest technologies, collaborate with highly skilled professionals, and accelerate your career in a culture that values learning, ownership, and continuous growth. If you're passionate about innovation and want to build solutions that make a real\-world impact,
 **Celebal Technologies is the place to be!** 




  





  





  





**Role Summary** 




  





  





 We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer\-facing, consulting\-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future\-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Lead pre\-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through to implementation oversight.
* Design end\-to\-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.
* Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake, on\-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.
* Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features
* Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production\-grade ETL with built in data quality and lineage
* Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources
* Serverless Compute (SQL warehouses, jobs, notebooks) for cost and operational efficiency
* Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine\-grained access control
* Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion
* Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader
* Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self\-service analytics
* MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads
* Conduct architecture deep\-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modeling, performance benchmarking, DR design, and platform sizing.
* Produce client\-ready deliverables: HLD/LLD documents, reference architectures, migration roadmaps, runbooks, and executive presentations.
* Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.
* Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.
* Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 8\+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3\+ years hands\-on on Databricks in a customer\-facing or consulting capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large\-scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end\-to\-end.
* Strong, fundamentals\-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
* Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z\-ORDER, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vectors, Predictive Optimization).
* Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.
* Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, storage credentials).
* Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.
* Hands\-on experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Connect, and Serverless workloads in production.
* Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance frameworks.
* Strong SQL and PySpark skills; comfort reading and reasoning about Spark execution plans.
* Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP — including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to engage equally with engineers and C\-suite.
* Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Databricks certifications: Certified Data Engineer Professional, Certified Machine Learning Professional, or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect Professional.
* Experience with DR architectures (Delta Deep Clone, cross\-region replication, RPO/RTO design).
* Exposure to MLOps / GenAI patterns on Databricks (MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework).
* Familiarity with legacy ETL/ELT platforms (Informatica, ODI, SAS DI, DataStage, Talend) for migration credibility.
* Experience with Terraform / Databricks Asset Bundles for IaC and CI/CD.
* Working knowledge of Immuta, Collibra, Purview, or Alation for governance integration.
* Industry depth in BFSI, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, or Healthcare.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Owned the architecture for at least 2 strategic customer engagements from discovery to go\-live.
* Established yourself as the go\-to advisor on advanced Databricks adoption (LDP, Lakeflow Connect, Serverless) within the practice.
* Contributed to reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and migration playbooks that scale across the practice.
* Built strong working relationships with Databricks field teams and contributed to joint pursuits.
